title: Research Assistant followed by a Double Degree PhD position in Urban Design and Pedestrian Experience with AI and VR
employer: KU - SCIENCE - IGN frb campus omr. 3
description:
Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen Within the European Union’s Horizon Europe research and innovation programme under the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action (MSCA), University of Copenhagen is offering a 1-year Research Assistant (RA) position starting 1 April 2027 (or as soon as possible thereafter), which then leads to a 3-year PhD fellowship for a Doctoral Candidate (DC). The combined position is part of the research project STEP-UP (Safe, Thriving, and Engaged Pedestrians in Urban Public Spaces), which is funded by the European Union’s Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions (MSCA), Doctoral Networks (DN), Call: HORIZON-MSCA-2025-DN-01. The STEP-UP network supports 10 PhD Candidates in investigating pedestrian behaviour and mobility in urban environments. The 10 PhD projects are closely linked, contributing complementary perspectives to a shared research agenda in three areas: individual and interpersonal aspects of pedestrian behaviour, environmental and infrastructural barriers to walking, and interactions between pedestrians and other road users. The aim is to improve the understanding of pedestrian mobility and support the development of safer and more inclusive urban public spaces. STEP-UP brings together academic and non-academic partners to train 10 doctoral candidates through an international Joint Doctorate programme. The candidates benefit from joint supervision by researchers at partner institutions, an integrated doctoral training programme, and opportunities for interdisciplinary and cross-sectoral collaboration, including research secondments at partner organisations. In addition to specialised scientific knowledge, they develop transferable skills in areas such as research communication and dissemination. The programme prepares them for careers in research and other fields related to transport and urban development. For a description of the STEP-UP project and descriptions of all 10 PhD positions, please visit the STEP-UP project’s website https://www.project-stepup.eu/ STEP-UP is based on 4-year double PhD degree programs. This means that the successful applicant will also be enrolled in a partner university’s PhD programme. Job and project description The RA position will entail carrying out a literature review of the research field, identifying current research gaps, and preparing for data collection. The PhD position will entail carrying out the research activities of the research project as described below. Your key tasks as a PhD fellow at the Faculty of SCIENCE are to:
  • Conduct an independent research project under supervision.
  • Complete PhD courses or other equivalent education corresponding to approximately 30 ECTS points.
  • Participate in active research environments including a mandatory stay for a minimum of 12 months at the partner university (see below for further details).
  • Contribute to teaching or other types of dissemination related to your PhD project (e.g., at conferences, meetings, etc.)
  • Write a PhD thesis on the grounds of your project
About the research project The project “Urban space transformation projects for improved and inclusive walkability”. will investigate how planning and design approaches applied in urban space transformation projects impact pedestrians’ behaviour and perceived safety and accessibility (walkability). Urban transformation projects are increasingly proposed to respond to the evolving needs of contemporary cities. Combining urban planning and transport engineering is essential, as planning shapes the spatial and social context of urban spaces while transport engineering ensures safe, efficient and accessible movement. The PhD project will: (1) collect data on goals and practices of urban space transformation projects; pedestrian pedestrians’ behaviours, preferences and perceptions of walkability in relation to the transformation interventions; (2) identify walkability indicators across diverse groups of pedestrians; (3) comprehensively evaluate pedestrians’ perceived impacts of current transformations for enhanced liveability and pedestrianisation; and (4) develop a methodological framework for local adaptation and upscaling of approaches for enhanced perceived walkability. Partner university: National Technical University of Athens (NTUA) Planned secondments at NTUA: M16–M24 and M37–M48. Pricipal supervisor: Assoc. Prof. Trine Agervig Carstensen, University of Copenhagen, email: tac@ign.ku.dk. Co-supervisor: Prof. Konstantinos Kepaptsoglou, National Technical University of Athens (NTUA), email: kkepap@central.ntua.gr Place of employment The primary place of employment will be Department of Geosciences and Natural Resource Management, Faculty of SCIENCE, University of Copenhagen. We offer creative and stimulating working conditions in dynamic and international research environment. Our research facilities include modern laboratories and state-of-the-art hardware and software. More information on the department can be found here: https://ign.ku.dk/english/ During the PhD programme of research the candidate will be on a secondment for minimum 12 months in total at the partner university. Required qualifications As an applicant you must have:
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at UCPH, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project, e.g. Urban Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Psychology, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Sociology, or related-disciplines. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database.
  • To be eligible for the PhD programme at the National University of Athens, you are required to fulfil the requirements described here: https://eur02.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.survey.ntua.gr%2Fen%2Fstudies%2Fpostgraduate%2Fdoctoral-studies&data=05%7C02%7Ctac%40ign.ku.dk%7Ce197702553f44a00a12308df44a25d10%7Ca3927f91cda14696af898c9f1ceffa91%7C0%7C0%7C639305136264965933%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJFbXB0eU1hcGkiOnRydWUsIlYiOiIwLjAuMDAwMCIsIlAiOiJXaW4zMiIsIkFOIjoiTWFpbCIsIldUIjoyfQ%3D%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C&sdata=62PInKwPpyGrwa3VViUOFLlXisPlz4b7rgs6kdWwhNI%3D&reserved=0
  • Fluency in English and excellent communications skills.
Applicants will also be required to meet the European Commission’s MSCA Doctoral Network eligibility criteria, notably:
  • Mobility Rule - Applicants can be of any nationality and must not have resided or carried out their main activity (work, studies, etc.) in Denmark for more than 12 months in the 36 months immediately before the start of their employment at UCPH. Compulsory national service, short stays such as holidays, and time spent as part of a procedure for obtaining refugee status under the Geneva Convention are not considered.
  • Doctoral Candidate requirement – the applicant must not be in possession of a doctoral degree at the first day of the employment. Researchers who have successfully defended their doctoral thesis, but who have not yet been awarded the doctoral degree are not eligible.
Please note that you will only be considered for the position if you fulfil both above eligibility criteria. Who are we looking for? We are looking for candidates within the field(s) of spatial, engineering, or behavioural sciences. Applicants can have a background in Urban and Regional Planning, Geography, Civil Engineering, Architecture, Landscape Architecture, Psychology, Sociology, or related disciplines. The following experiences and skills will be emphasised. Applicants are encouraged to provide relevant details and supporting evidence, where applicable:
  • Urban design / urban planning
  • Human-environment interactions
  • Qualitative case study methods
  • Data analysis / statistical analysis
Personal attributes that are desirable:
  • Strong motivation for high-quality research
  • Collaborative spirit
  • Systematic approach to research
  • Attention to detail
Key criteria for the assessment of applicants
  • Professional qualifications relevant to the PhD project
  • Relevance of studies, coursework, and thesis
  • Relevant work experience (if any)
  • Publications (if any)
  • The grade point average achieved
  • Other professional activities
  • Language skills
  • Quality and relevance of project proposal
  • The successful applicant is also required to be enterprising and to possess good interpersonal skills
Terms of employment The arrangement concerns two separate fixed-term positions: initially as a Research Assistant, leading towards an appointment as a PhD fellow. The respective durations of the two positions are 1 year and 3 years. The position as a PhD fellow is contingent upon the successful enrolment of a suitable candidate in the PhD School at the University of Copenhagen, as well as satisfactory completion of the Research Assistant period. These assessments will be carried out 3-6 months prior to the expiry of the Research Assistant contract. The start date is 1 April 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. The PhD study must be completed in accordance with The Ministerial Order on the PhD programme (2013) and the faculty’s rules on achieving the degree. Salary, pension and terms of employment are in accordance with the requirements from the European Commission related to the MSCA programme and the agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and The Danish Confederation of Professional Associations on Academics in the State. Depending on seniority, the monthly salary starts at approximately 31,850 DKK/roughly 4,260 EUR (August 2026 level). Depending on qualifications, a supplement may be negotiated. The employer will pay an additional 18.07 % to your pension fund. Application and assessment procedure Your application, written in English, must be submitted electronically by clicking “Apply now” below and must include the following documents in PDF format:
  • Motivation letter of application (max. one page)
  • A project proposal (max 5 pages where the candidate presents a proposal on how they wish to approach their project including theory and methods)
  • CV incl. education, experience, language skills, publication list (if any), and other skills relevant for the position
  • Certified copy of original master’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If not completed, a certified/signed copy of a recent transcript of records or a written statement from the institution or supervisor is accepted. As a prerequisite for a PhD position employment, you must have completed a degree programme, equivalent to a Danish master’s degree (180 ECTS/3 FTE BSc + 120 ECTS/2 FTE MSc) related to the subject area of the project. For information of eligibility of completed programmes, see General assessments for specific countries and Assessment database. Please note that we might ask you to obtain an assessment of your education performed by the Ministry of Higher Education and Science. Applicants with a master´s degree from abroad should also enclose a short description of the grading scale used. Certified copy of original bachelor’s diploma and transcript of records in the original language, including an authorised English translation if issued in other language than English or Danish. If the applicant has completed a combined bachelor’s and master’s education (e.g. 5-year combined master’s), the applicant should submit the combined diploma, transcript of records, and authorised English translations if issued in other language than English or Danish.
  • Language diplomas or language test results (if any)
The deadline for applications is 20 December 2026, at 23.59pm CET. We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements. The further process After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorised recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. The assessor makes a non-prioritised assessment of the academic qualifications and experience with respect to the above-mentioned area of research, techniques, skills and other requirements listed in the advertisement. Once the assessment work has been completed, each applicant can comment on the part of the assessment that relates to him/herself. The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities. You may read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/ For more information on working and living in Denmark visit http://ism.ku.dk (International Staff Mobility) and https://www.workindenmark.dk. Interviews are expected to take place in the beginning of February 2027. Questions For specific information about the PhD position, please contact the principal supervisor, Trine Agervig Carstensen. The University of Copenhagen wishes to reflect the diversity of society and encourages all qualified candidates to apply regardless of personal background.

title: Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S / Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S
description:
Driver for Day Distribution at NAKA A/S

Chauffør til dagdistribution hos NAKA A/S

NAKA A/S vokser, og vi søger nu en stabil og ansvarsbevidst chauffør til dagdistribution. Du bliver en del af et professionelt team, hvor kvalitet, punktlighed og god kundeservice er en naturlig del af hverdagen.

Om NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics er en transportvirksomhed med hovedsæde i Trekantsområdet. Vores centrale placering og vores dygtige medarbejdere gør os i stand til at løfte både store og små opgaver effektivt.Vi leverer hurtige og præcise løsninger til enhver transportopgave, og med eget værksted holder vi vores biler kørende 24 timer i døgnet – samtidig med at vi holder omkostningerne nede.

Om jobbet

Vi søger en fleksibel og ansvarsfuld chauffør til vores velfungerende team. Hos os er samarbejde vigtigt – vi hjælper hinanden, så dagens opgaver løses effektivt og uden unødige problemer.

Dine primære opgaver vil være:

  • Kørsel med lastbil i dagdistribution

  • Levering og aflæsning hos faste kunder

  • Sortering og håndtering af gods ved pålæsning

  • Arbejdstid typisk mellem 06:00–17:00

Du får naturligvis en grundig oplæring, hvor du kører med en af vores erfarne chauffører, så du lærer ruter, procedurer og arbejdspladsen at kende. Vi står altid klar til at hjælpe, hvis der opstår udfordringer undervejs.

Vi forventer, at du:

  • Har kørekort C og/eller CE

  • Har gennemført lastbilchaufføruddannelsen

  • Er mødestabil, selvstændig og ansvarsbevidst

  • Har god fysik og kan håndtere gods

  • Trives med dagarbejde og faste rutiner

  • Kan kommunikere venligt og professionelt med kunder og disponenter

  • Har erfaring med distribution eller lignende kørsel

  • En fast stilling i en virksomhed med ordnede forhold

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig og ser frem til et godt samarbejde.

NAKA A/S is growing, and we are now looking for a reliable and responsible truck driver for day distribution. You will become part of a professional team where quality, punctuality, and excellent customer service are a natural part of everyday work.

About NAKA A/S

NAKA Logistics is a transport company headquartered in the Triangle Region of Denmark. Our central location and skilled employees enable us to handle both large and small transport assignments efficiently.

We provide fast and precise solutions for every transport task, and with our own workshop, we keep our fleet running 24 hours a day while maintaining cost efficiency.

We are looking for a flexible and responsible driver to join our well-functioning team. Teamwork is important to us, and we help each other ensure that daily tasks are completed efficiently and without unnecessary issues.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

  • Driving a truck on day distribution routes

  • Salary based on qualifications and experience

job@naka.dk

title: Volljurist M&A  (m/w/d) (Jurist/in)
description: Unser Mandant European Energy ist ein privat geführtes, international stark wachsendes Unternehmen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien. Seit 2004 entwickelt, realisiert, betreibt und veräußert das dänische Unternehmen Wind- und Photovoltaikprojekte und treibt mit zukunftsweisenden Lösungen wie Power-to-X die Energieversorgung von morgen voran.Mehr als 800 Mitarbeitende aus 44 Nationalitäten in 21 Ländern arbeiten an der gemeinsamen Vision, einen maßgeblichen Beitrag zur globalen Transformation hin zu einer fossilfreien Zukunft zu leisten.Die international aufgestellte Rechtsabteilung umfasst 17 Juristinnen und Juristen mit Expertise unter anderem im Gesellschafts-, Bau- und Immobilienrecht, M&A, bei Finanzierungstransaktionen sowie im Wirtschafts- und Vertragsrecht. Das Team begleitet großvolumige Wind- und Solarprojekte über den gesamten Projektzyklus, von der Entwicklung und dem Erwerb über die Finanzierung und Realisierung bis hin zur Veräußerung.The Power of Tomorrow, Today.Ihre Vorteile:- Abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einer zukunftsträchtigen Branche und einem schnell wachsenden, international agierenden Unternehmen- Hoher Verantwortungsgrad und unmittelbare Einbindung in strategisch bedeutende technologieübergreifende Energie- und Infrastrukturprojekte- Moderne Arbeitsumgebung mit flexiblen Strukturen, angenehmer Arbeitsatmosphäre, professionellen Teams und kurzen Entscheidungswegen- Attraktives Vergütungspaket- Relocation-SupportIhre Aufgaben:- Eigenständige Begleitung von projektbezogenen M&A-Transaktionen im Bereich erneuerbarer Energie- und Infrastrukturprojekte- Gestaltung, Prüfung und Verhandlung von (inter-)nationalen Verträgen (z.B. SPA, Joint-Venture-Vereinbarungen, Kooperationsverträge sowie kommerzielle Projektverträge)- Rechtliche Begleitung von der Projektentwicklung über die Bauphase bis zur Inbetriebnahme inkl. Due Diligence, Verhandlungen und Closing- Durchführung von Risikoanalysen sowie Entwicklung pragmatischer, wirtschaftlich sinnvoller Lösungen- Enge Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Fachabteilungen wie der Projektentwicklung, Technik, Finance und dem Management- Aufbau und Pflege vertrauensvoller interner Stakeholder-Beziehungen im internationalen Umfeld- Entwicklung innovativer Vertrags- und Strukturmodelle für anspruchsvolle Energie- und Infrastrukturvorhaben- Mitwirkung an der Weiterentwicklung standardisierter Vertrags- und ProzesslandschaftenIhre Qualifikationen:- Volljurist mit überdurchschnittlichen Staatsexamina- Einschlägige Berufserfahrung durch die Tätigkeit in einer renommierten Kanzlei und ggf. zusätzlicher Inhouse-Expertise- Erfahrung im M&A-Bereich, bevorzugt im Projekt-, Infrastruktur- oder Real-Estate-Umfeld- Souveränes Drafting komplexer wirtschaftsrechtlicher Verträge (SPA, JV, Commercial Contracts)- Analytische, strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Problemlösungskompetenz- Pragmatismus und wirtschaftliches Verständnis- Hohe Eigenständigkeit, Verantwortungsbereitschaft und Entscheidungsfreude- Ausgeprägte Teamfähigkeit, Offenheit und Kommunikationsstärke- Freude an der Arbeit in einem dynamischen, internationalen und unternehmerischen UmfeldÜber Hays:Als eines der größten Personalberatungsunternehmen für den juristischen Markt zählt Hays zu den ersten Adressen für Rechtsexperten und Rechtsexpertinnen, die sich hohe Ziele gesteckt haben und in der Lage sind, diese auch zu erreichen. Dies gilt gleichermaßen für engagierte Berufsanfänger und Berufsanfängerinnen als auch für erfahrene Juristen und Juristinnen, die sich im Kanzlei- oder Unternehmensumfeld verändern möchten. Seit 1991 bietet Hays die Personalberatung und Personalvermittlung im Legal-Bereich an. Unser Consultingteam verfügt über tiefgreifende Expertise und hat einen Blick für Details, die zwischen Unterschrift und Absage entscheiden können. Sie können sich völlig kostenfrei registrieren und von interessanten und passenden Positionen profitieren.

title: Key Account Manager
description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping. As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the jobReady to make a positive impact? We are glad to present this opportunity to join a great team at a highly innovative company as we are looking for a Key Account Manager. This is a role where you will be responsible for driving profitable growth and strengthening long-term partnerships with some of Alfa Laval's most important customers across Denmark and Sweden within the food and pharmaceutical industries.You will serve as the customer's trusted advisor and main point of contact, coordinating closely with technical specialists, service teams, inside sales, and other stakeholders across the organization, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction. The customers that you will serve are mainly pharma customers. Your primary focus will be:    Proactive sales - developing existing strategic accounts by understanding customer needs.    Identifying new business opportunities and following up leads.    Coordination/meeting optimization with internal and external stakeholders. Success in this role requires a strong commercial mindset, excellent relationship-building skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations and decision-making processes.You will be part of a team of ten and have a key role in further contributing to our customers' and Alfa Lavals growth. You report to Tina Masini Tarp, a manager who aims to create a collaborative environment where people feel trusted, take ownership, and contribute to shared success. Who are youYou are a commercially driven and customer-focused professional who enjoys building long-term relationships and creating value for customers. You actively engage and network with stakeholders, understand business challenges, and translate customer needs into opportunities. You are proactive, structured, and comfortable taking ownership while collaborating across functions and cultures. Most importantly, you are motivated by developing strategic partnerships and delivering sustainable business growth. What you knowWe are looking for you with experience within Key Account Management, Technical Sales, Business Development and/or Strategic Sales. You need the ability to understand technical solutions and connect them to customer value as well as being able to work independently while collaborating effectively across functions and countries. Requirement:    Experience working with larger industrial customers, preferably within pharma, food, beverage, dairy, or related industries.    Strong commercial understanding and negotiation skills.    Experience with CRM systems and sales planning tools.    Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business, Engineering, Food Technology, Process Engineering, or a related field.    Excellent communication and presentation skills in English in addition to either Swedish or Danish (depending on your location)    Driving licence For more information, please contactTina Masini Tarp, Market Area Manager, Food & Pharma at or Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner We are conducting a continuous review of received applications.We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).Please send your application no later than December 10, 2026. At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in or have an established presence in the area of Søborg, Denmark.  Our commitment to integrityWe care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.#LI-CL1

title: Are you a Flight Instructor? Explore Multiple Career Paths at Greybird, no matter your level.
description:
GreyBird Pilot Academy is expanding and is looking for Flight Instructors to join our team fulltime or parttime in Denmark.

Are you passionate about training and developing the next generation of commercial pilots? Do you thrive in a professional aviation environment where you can combine flight instruction with classroom and simulator-based teaching?

Three profile opportunities

Whether you are a newly graduated or an experienced Flight Instructor, already hold CRI/SPA privileges, or are ready to take the next step through our sponsored development program, we offer exciting opportunities to build your aviation career while helping future pilots achieve their goals:

Career Path 1: Flight Instructor – Sponsored CRI/SPA Program

About the Role

This position is designed for pilots who meet the requirements for CRI/SPA training but have not yet obtained the qualification.

As a Flight Instructor, you will deliver flight training, simulator instruction, and classroom teaching while participating in our sponsored development pathway.

Sponsored Development Opportunity

GreyBird will sponsor the CRI/SPA training required for the role if you meet the eligibility criteria below.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for sponsorship for a full-time position based at Aarhus Airport in Denmark, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • Experience as PIC on MEP aircraft

  • Meet EASA FCL requirements for:

  • CRI/SPA ME, or

  • IRI MEP

Read more and apply here

Career Path 2: Flight Instructor CRI/SPA/(ME) (fulltime / or flexible planned partime)

About the Role

This position is aimed at experienced instructors already holding CRI/SPA qualifications.

You will primarily conduct flight training and may also deliver simulator and classroom instruction as part of our integrated training programs.

For candidates with these qualifications, GreyBird offers a full-time position or a flexible employment for candidates who are interested in a combination of working as an instructor at GreyBird and an airline job or commute between residence and Aarhus airport.

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • EASA ATPL or CPL

  • CRI/SPA qualification (mandatory)

  • ME qualification (preferred but not required)

  • Valid Flight Instructor Certificate (FI)

Read more and apply here

Career Path 3: Chief Flight Instructor - Denmark

About the Role

This position come with

  • Real decision-making authority over training quality and standards in a growing international organisation

  • A direct reporting line to the Head of Training and close ties to management

  • An established ATO with a clear, EASA-approved framework for the role

  • Access to a modern and growing fleet

  • An international working environment with colleagues and instructors from several countries

Mandatory Requirements

To be considered for this position, you must have:

  • CPL(A) or ATPL(A)

  • Instructor certificate: FI(A)

  • Fluent English, spoken and written

Read more and apply here

If you meet the requirements for one of the three career paths, we encourage you to apply for the position that matches your current qualifications.

Join GreyBird Pilot Academy and help shape the future of aviation.

We can’t wait to hear from you.

title: Restaurant Manager
description:
About Mr Bittu ApS

Mr Bittu ApS is an Indian restaurant based in Bagsværd, Denmark. We serve a variety of Indian street food, traditional dishes and curry specialities.

We are looking for a responsible, experienced and motivated person who can contribute to our kitchen operations and help manage the daily running of the restaurant.

About the position

We are seeking a "Restaurant Manager" to support food preparation, kitchen operations, staff coordination and the day-to-day management of the restaurant.

The successful candidate will work closely with the restaurant management to maintain food quality, service standards, hygiene and efficient daily operations.

Key responsibilities

Kitchen responsibilities

- Maintain consistency in food quality, taste and presentation.

- Monitor kitchen stock and assist with ordering ingredients.

- Maintain cleanliness and follow food safety and hygiene procedures.

- Organise kitchen tasks and coordinate daily food preparation.

Restaurant management responsibilities

- Assist with the daily operation and organisation of the restaurant.

- Coordinate kitchen and service staff during working shifts.

- Help organise staff schedules and daily work assignments.

- Monitor customer service and handle customer enquiries or complaints professionally.

- Support inventory control, stock management and supplier coordination.

- Monitor food costs, minimise waste and support efficient operations.

- Ensure that restaurant procedures and hygiene standards are followed.

Qualifications and experience

We expect the candidate to have:

- Previous experience in a restaurant kitchen and food preparation.

- Knowledge of Indian cuisine, including Indian street food and curry dishes.

- Understanding of kitchen hygiene, food safety and stock handling.

- Experience or ability to coordinate staff and organise daily restaurant operations.

- Good communication and teamwork skills.

- A responsible, organised and flexible approach to work.

- Ability to work independently and under pressure during busy periods.

Experience in both kitchen operations and restaurant supervision will be considered an advantage.

Language requirements

- Good English communication skills.

- Knowledge of Danish or other relevant languages is an advantage.

Working conditions

- Permanent employment.

- Full-time position.

- Work may include daytime, evening and weekend shifts according to the restaurant's opening hours and operational needs.

- Salary and employment terms will be agreed according to qualifications, experience and applicable Danish employment standards.

- Holiday and other employment conditions will be stated in the employment contract.

How to apply

Interested candidates are invited to submit their CV and a short application explaining their relevant experience.

Apply by email: info@mrbittu.dk

Website: https://mrbittu.dk

Work location: Bagsværd Hovedgade 116M, 2880 Bagsværd, Denmark

We look forward to receiving applications from motivated candidates who would like to become part of our restaurant team.

title: Full-Time Pizza Chef – New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg
description:
Full-Time Pizza Chef – New Italian Restaurant in Esbjerg

We’re opening an Italian restaurant in Esbjerg with a dedicated Neapolitan pizza menu. We’re looking for an experienced pizza chef to take charge of the pizza station, from mixing the dough and preparing the toppings to baking pizzas for both dine-in and takeaway.

What you’ll do

  • Make the dough. Mix, portion and ball the dough, and manage fermentation so each batch is ready for service.

  • Prepare the station. Make sauces, prep toppings and plan quantities with the Head Chef based on expected orders.

  • Run pizza service. Stretch each base by hand, top and bake the pizzas, and coordinate dine-in and takeaway orders with the rest of the kitchen.

  • Help shape the menu. Work with the Head Chef to test recipes and develop the pizza selection before opening.

About you

You have hands-on experience making Neapolitan pizza and feel confident managing dough from mixing to baking. You can read the dough, judge when it’s ready to stretch and keep an eye on the bake when several orders come in at once.

You enjoy running your own station and working closely with the kitchen team. Joining before opening means you’ll have a say in how the pizza station is set up and how service runs.

Location: Esbjerg · Position: Full-time · Start date: Flexible

Interested? Apply through this listing with your CV and a few lines about your experience making Neapolitan pizza.

title: Praktisk medarbejder til heste- og smådyrsværksted på Tinnetgaard
description:
Vil du bruge dine praktiske kompetencer og din erfaring med heste i et meningsfuldt pædagogisk arbejde med unge?  

På Tinnetgaard søger vi en engageret og praktisk stærk medarbejder til vores heste- og smådyrsværksted. Stillingen rummer både drift, dyrehold og pædagogisk arbejde med unge med særlige behov. Heste- og smådyrsværkstedet er en central del af vores tilbud. Her bruger vi arbejdet med dyr og natur som en ramme for ansvar, mestring, ro og relation. 

Om Tinnetgaard 

Tinnetgaard er en Bo- og Erhvervsskole for unge med særlige behov. Vores pædagogiske tilgang er praksisnær og relations båret. Vi arbejder med struktur, tydelighed og meningsfulde aktiviteter som fundament for trivsel og udvikling. 

Om stillingen 

Stillingen forener to spor: 

Det praktiske og landbrugsfaglige 

  • Daglig pasning, fodring og pleje af heste og smådyr 

  • Håndtering, træning og generel hestefaglig vurdering 

  • Rengøring og vedligeholdelse af hegn, udearealer, mv og struktur i driften 

Det pædagogiske arbejde 

  • Inddragelse af de unge i daglige opgaver 

  • Skabe trygge, forudsigelige rammer og tydelig struktur 

  • Arbejde relations orienteret og anerkendende 

  • Understøtte de unges udvikling gennem ansvar og praktisk deltagelse 

  • Samarbejde tværfagligt med kolleger omkring den enkelte unge 

Du skal kunne balancere faglig tydelighed med ro og rummelighed. Arbejdet kræver både praktisk handlekraft og pædagogisk forståelse. 

 

Vi søger dig, der: 

  • Har erfaring med heste og praktisk arbejde i omkring heste  

  • Har erfaring med traktorkørsel og maskinkendskab 

  • Trives med fysisk arbejde og udendørsopgaver året rundt 

  • Har interesse for – eller erfaring med – unge med særlige behov 

  • Er robust, stabil og relations kompetent 

  • Kan sætte tydelige rammer og bevare roen 

  • Arbejder selvstændigt og tager ansvar for både dyr og mennesker 

  • Pædagogisk erfaring er en fordel, men ikke et krav, hvis du har den rette erfaring og tilgang. 

  • Er indstillet på varierede arbejdstider. Arbejdet indebærer en aftenvagt om uge og weekendarbejde ca. hver 3. weekend.  

  • Stillingen er en 37 timers stilling. 

Tiltrædelse snarest muligt.  

Skriftlig ansøgning med referencer sendes til Henning Kristensen pr. mail til henning@tinnetgaard.dk Der er ingen rundvisning uden forudgående aftale. For yderlig information kan Henning kontaktes på 2752-2946.  

Vi ansætter når den rette ansøger er fundet.  

Læs om Tinnetgaard på www.tinnetgaard.dk eller på vores Facebook.

title: Project Engineer - BoP Support; Location: DK - Esbjerg, DK - Copenhagen, DK - Aarhus, DE - Hamburg, DE - Emden
description:
Do you have a strong technical mindset and a passion for structure, quality, and well-prepared offshore execution? Do you want to play a key role in ensuring that service campaigns are executed safely, efficiently, and with the highest documentation standards? Then you might be our new Project Engineer within Balance of Plant Support at Semco Maritime. Your positionAs our new Project Engineer, you will be a vital part of the Balance of Plant Support team, where your primary responsibility will be to ensure the technical preparation and documentation required for safe and efficient offshore execution.You will work closely with Project Managers, Site Managers, HSE, and engineering disciplines to ensure that all documentation — including RAMS, checklists, and execution plans — is complete, accurate, and aligned with project and client requirements. In this role, you will be at the forefront of ensuring documentation excellence and quality across our service projects.At Semco Maritime, safety is a core value, and through your work you will actively contribute to maintaining and strengthening our safety culture by ensuring that offshore activities are thoroughly prepared and documented.Your place of work will be at either Global HQ in Esbjerg, in Copenhagen, in Aarhus, in Hamburg or in Emden in Germany, with occasional travel related to service campaigns. The position is full-time. “High-quality technical preparation is the foundation for safe offshore execution. In this role, you will make a direct impact on how our projects are prepared and delivered.”  - Senior Manager, BoP Support, Michael Andersen Your tasks & responsibilitiesAs Project Engineer within BoP support, you will support the planning and execution of service activities through structured and high-quality documentation.Your key tasks will include:
  • Preparing and maintaining project documentation for offshore service activities
  • Developing RAMS, work descriptions, and execution plans in close collaboration with project teams
  • Creating and maintaining offshore checklists and readiness documentation
  • Ensuring documentation complies with internal standards, client requirements, and applicable regulations
  • Supporting Project Leaders and Site Managers with documentation reviews and updates
  • Ensuring high-quality reporting before, during, and after offshore execution
  • Contributing to continuous improvement of documentation standards, templates, and processes
  • Supporting tender activities by providing technical input, developing execution concepts, and contributing to scope, methodology, and resource planning
 Your profile & qualificationsWe are looking for a structured and detail-oriented Project Engineer who takes ownership of quality and thrives in a collaborative project environment.To succeed in this role, you likely have:
  • A relevant technical education, for example within marine, mechanical, electrical, offshore, or a similar engineering discipline
  • Experience in project engineering, service operations, or offshore execution (advantageous)
  • A good understanding of the requirements associated with offshore or industrial project execution
  • Experience working with RAMS, work packs, Service Reporting or other execution documentation
  • A high focus on quality, structure, and accuracy
  • Strong communication skills in English. German is considered an advantage
  • A proactive and solution-oriented mindset
Welcome to Semco MaritimeAt Semco Maritime, we create change. For people. For projects. And for the global energy sector. With us, you will join a community of over 2,300 of the most dedicated thinkers and doers in the energy industry who are driving real change and making their own personal mark on the global energy landscape.While everyone knows why the energy transition is vital, we are concerned with the journey. How to get there. By providing the answers needed to make change real. Because we believe that global energy ambitions can only be realized through hard work and clever pragmatic solutions. This is what we do. This is what we invite you to participate in.Safety is at the core of everything we do, and we are committed to protecting our people, partners, and the planet as we work towards a sustainable energy future.So yes, working for us will change the energy sector – and may well change you too.Care to join the movement?Change. With us.Semco Maritime is an international engineering and contracting company with 2,300 employees and 40 years of dedication rooted in both the conventional energy sector and the offshore wind industry. This puts us in a unique position to bridge today's and tomorrow’s solutions, constantly seeking clever and pragmatic ways to realise global energy ambitions. We do this through comprehensive project management across all phases of energy projects together with world-leading partners across the globe.

title: Massage Therapist (Zero hour Contract)
description:
The role:

As a Massage Therapist in our Copenhagen team, your role is to ensure clients' well-being by performing relaxing and cosmetic treatments following our established protocols. You'll also maintain our relaxation spaces in top condition with all the necessary materials for a perfect AIRE experience.

Key responsibilities:

Customer Experience:

  • Deliver relaxing treatments, including body and facial treatments and exfoliations, following AIRE's protocols and techniques for each. 

  • Clearly communicate treatment details and product information to clients, following our provided manual and protocols. 

  • Keep an ample supply of necessary products for customer experiences, promptly reporting any shortages or low stock. 

  • Maintain consistency in couples' treatments and coordinate effectively with partner therapists for a seamless experience.

Workplace:

  • Keep work areas clean and ready for customer experiences per company protocols. 

  • Supervise facility sanitation, product maintenance, and cleaning between treatments.  

  • Ensure environmental conditions meet protocol standards for noise, temperature, and humidity.

You'll receive thorough training to explore our diverse range of treatments and truly grasp the essence of AIRE's unique approach.

We're excited to welcome you to our team in Copenhagen and invite you to immerse yourself in the AIRE experience! 

Who we are looking for:

  • You hold a valid Massage Therapist course or certification

  • Fluent in English, and if you know Danish, that's a fantastic bonus!

  • You're genuinely customer-focused and excel at connecting with people

  • Your schedule is flexible, allowing you to work evenings, holidays, and weekends when necessary

Copenhagen location

About 

AIRE Ancient Baths offer a timeless relaxation experience, inspired by ancient Roman, Greek, and Ottoman traditions, set in restored historical buildings in major global cities.At AIRE, we're delighted to have a global presence with eight established centers in cities such as NYC, Chicago, London, Copenhagen, Barcelona, Sevilla, Almeria, and Vallromanes. Looking ahead, we're excited about our upcoming Los Angeles and Madrid facilities soon.

title: INDUSTRIAL TECHNICIAN / MACHINIST - Næstved, South Zealand, Denmark - APPLICANTS WITH EU-PASSPORT ONLY
description:
GREAT WORKSHOP • COMPETITIVE PAY • RELOCATION SUPPORT FOR YOU AND YOUR FAMILYAre you an experienced machinist or industrial technician looking for a new opportunity abroad? At Service Shoppen, we are looking for a skilled and motivated colleague who enjoys precision engineering, turning and varied workshop tasks. Would you like to work in Denmark, enjoy a good work-life balance and become part of a friendly and professional workshop team? We would love to hear from you!A NEW JOB – AND SUPPORT WITH YOUR MOVE TO DENMARKMoving to another country is a big step, especially if you are bringing your family. We will help you get settled in Denmark – from airport pick-up and temporary accommodation to finding a permanent home and getting started with Danish language classes. If you wish to bring your family, we will also help you get started with the practical arrangements. Denmark offers good educational opportunities, schools and plenty of leisure activities for children and adults.THE JOBYour main responsibility will be NC turning, including working with our Weiler lathes, which can be operated both manually and through NC control. You will also take part in other varied workshop and production tasks. Set up, program and operate NC lathes. Perform manual turning when required. Read and understand technical drawings. Ensure high quality and precision in your work. Contribute to varied workshop tasks and suggest improvements.WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? You are a qualified Industrial Technician / Machinist or have relevant professional experience. You have experience with NC turning or CNC turning. You can work independently, take responsibility and take pride in quality work. You enjoy variety, teamwork and developing your skills. You can communicate in English. Danish is not required when you start. A valid EU passport is a requirement for this position.YOUR RELOCATION TO DENMARK – WE WILL HELPAIRPORT PICK-UPWe will pick you up at the airport and take you to your accommodation when you arrive.TEMPORARY ACCOMMODATIONIf needed, we will help arrange an apartment, a room or temporary bed & breakfast accommodation while you look for a permanent home.FINDING A HOMEWe will assist you in finding suitable permanent accommodation in Denmark.DANISH LANGUAGE SCHOOL & PRACTICAL HELPWe will help you get started with Danish language classes and guide you through practical matters related to settling in Denmark.PERSONAL CONTACT: Both of our managers speak English, and one of them is also fluent in Spanish. You will have someone to communicate with throughout the process and someone to turn to if you have questions.WHAT WE OFFER
  • DKK 205 per hour
  • 37 hours per week
  • 5 weeks + 1 additional week of holiday
You will also receive: An additional 10% of your salary through our free-choice scheme (fritvalgsordning), paid out twice a year. Employment conditions are covered by the DI/CO collective agreement, ensuring fair pay and proper working conditions. A flexible working environment. Thorough training and a proper introduction to your new job. Varied and interesting workshop tasks. A friendly and informal workshop with a strong professional focus.Holiday: 5 weeks of annual holiday plus 1 additional week of holiday days. Public holidays are also days off.ABOUT SERVICE SHOPPENAt Service Shoppen, you will become part of a professional workshop environment where precision, quality and practical skills are important. title: Product Manager
description:
Description & Expectation:

Quadsat is looking for an experienced Product Manager to join the R&D team and take a key role in shaping and driving our defence product portfolio.

You will join the R&D organisation and work at the intersection of technology, customers, and business. The role combines strategic product management, defining product direction, priorities, positioning, and roadmap, with the operational responsibility of turning that direction into clear development priorities and ensuring progress across the organisation.

Our defence products combine RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into integrated solutions for the detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

You will work closely with engineering, commercial teams, partners, and end users to understand operational needs, translate market and customer insight into product priorities, manage and communicate the product roadmap, and help drive development from early concepts through product releases and continued improvement.

This is a role for someone who enjoys moving between the big picture and the detail: understanding where the product needs to go, while also staying close enough to development, customers, and delivery to help make it happen.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to take end-to-end ownership of product development and evolution. You will:

  • Own and drive product roadmaps aligned with Quadsat's strategy, market opportunities, and customer needs.
  • Translate customer, operational, and commercial input into clear product priorities and development initiatives.
  • Drive development from concept through implementation, validation, release, and continued improvement.
  • Maintain an overview of scope, timelines, dependencies, risks, and progress, and communicate product status clearly across the organisation.
  • Work closely with engineers and technical leads to understand feasibility, effort, and realistic timelines for new capabilities and customer requests.
  • Collaborate with the R&D Director on prioritisation, resource planning, and allocation of engineering capacity across product lines.
  • Facilitate collaboration across R&D, Business Development, Marketing, Production, Quality, and other key stakeholders.
  • Stay close to customers, partners, and the defence industry, working with the commercial organisation to understand emerging needs and translate them into product direction.

The role offers significant ownership and the opportunity to influence both what we build and how we bring it to market, while remaining closely involved in the technical development required to make it happen.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in an engineering field, combined with strong practical experience in a similar role as a product or project manager.

In addition, you bring:

  • Experience translating customer or market needs into technical products and development priorities.
  • Experience within product management, technical product management, technical project management, or a similar role.
  • Experience from the defence industry or another mission-critical technical domain.
  • A strong technical understanding and the ability to work effectively with multidisciplinary engineering teams.
  • Fluency in English (both written and oral).

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact & Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

title: RF Systems Architect
description:
Description & Expectation

Quadsat is looking for an experienced RF Systems Architect to join the RF team working on SpectraLoc, our defense product for detection, analysis, and geolocation of RF emitters.

This role will focus on RF front-end architecture, coherent receiver design, RF chain optimization, PCB design and layout, measurement integrity, and the continued productization of SpectraLoc. You will help strengthen the RF hardware foundation needed for robust product performance, certification readiness, and future next-generation RF architectures.

SpectraLoc combines RF sensing payloads, drone-based operations, mission control software, signal processing, geolocation algorithms, and operator-facing workflows into one integrated product. You will work closely with engineers spanning from RF, DSP, software, embedded, and FPGA specialist, with your primary focus being to improve RF system quality, hardware robustness, and the measurement integrity of the sensing chain.

For this role it is a requirement that you can confirm that you are eligible to be security cleared by the Danish Defense Intelligence Service.

Responsibilities:

Your main responsibility will be to develop, improve, and mature RF hardware and RF system architectures that support reliable RF sensing, geolocation, and future coherent receiver capabilities.

You will:

  • Design, develop, and optimize RF front-end architectures for RF sensing and geolocation applications.
  • Contribute to coherent receiver design, multi-channel RF architectures, and future direction-finding capabilities based on phase-coherent RF measurements.
  • Design and improve RF chains, including filtering, amplification, frequency conversion, gain distribution, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, and sensitivity trade-offs.
  • Support PCB design and layout for RF circuits, including component selection, schematic design, layout review, signal integrity, grounding, shielding, and manufacturability.
  • Improve measurement integrity across the RF sensing chain by identifying and reducing sources of uncertainty, drift, phase error, loss, interference, leakage, and calibration sensitivity.
  • Plan and perform RF measurements, verification, and troubleshooting using relevant RF test equipment such as spectrum analysers, VNAs, signal generators, power meters, and related tools.
  • Work with DSP and software engineers to ensure that RF hardware behavior, calibration data, and system limitations are understood and properly reflected in algorithm development and product performance.
  • Support product robustness, certification readiness, and design-for-manufacturing activities by improving RF hardware quality, documentation, repeatability, and testability.
  • Provide technical leadership within RF systems and hardware, helping raise the quality of Quadsat’s RF design, validation methodology, and overall sensing performance.

Knowledge & Skills:

We envision that you have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, RF Engineering, Microwave Engineering, Physics, or a related technical field, combined with strong practical experience in RF hardware development for RF sensing, SDR, radar, electronic warfare, SATCOM, aerospace, telecom, test and measurement, or other advanced RF systems.

More important than the exact degree is that you have hands-on experience designing, validating, and improving RF systems where measurement quality, robustness, and system performance matter.

In addition, you bring:

  • Strong practical experience with RF front-end design, RF chain architecture, and RF hardware development.
  • Experience with RF circuit design and PCB design/layout for high-frequency systems.
  • Solid understanding of RF system trade-offs, including gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, filtering, frequency conversion, phase noise, spurious signals, leakage, and sensitivity.
  • Practical experience with RF measurement, verification, debugging, and calibration using professional RF test equipment.
  • Understanding of coherent RF systems, including phase stability, synchronization, channel matching, LO distribution, timing effects, and calibration considerations.
  • Familiarity with antenna interfaces, propagation effects, polarization, multipath, and how RF hardware behavior affects sensing and geolocation performance.
  • Ability to define test methods, performance metrics, acceptance criteria, and validation approaches for RF hardware and RF sensing systems.
  • Experience collaborating with DSP, software, embedded, FPGA, mechanical, robotics, and product teams to turn RF hardware concepts into robust product capabilities.
  • A proactive mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to work independently while staying aligned with broader product and engineering priorities.

It would be highly advantageous if you also have experience with electronic warfare, radar systems, SIGINT, RF surveillance, phased arrays, coherent multi-channel receivers, interferometry, monopulse tracking, beamforming, calibration of RF sensing systems, MIL-STD certification, environmental robustness, SDR platforms, or transitioning RF hardware from prototype into production.

Our Dynamic Work Environment:

Quadsat is at an exciting stage of our growth journey where you can make a meaningful impact with your work, and directly influence the development of advanced solutions. You will join a diverse team of innovative colleagues who are passionate about working with new technology development. Our work environment is characterised by a high degree of openness, a flat management structure, and a strong sense of community where we work closely together on tasks.

You will be part of a driven engineering team across software, RF, robotics, and product development, with opportunities for professional growth, increased responsibility, and close involvement in real product innovation. We value initiative, collaboration, high-quality engineering, and people who want their work to matter beyond the codebase.

Contact and Questions:

This hiring is being managed in collaboration with our external recruitment partner, ESBEES. For questions reach out to Søren Bøge Sørensen by mail: sbs@esbeesheadhunting.com or by phone: +45 20 27 46 66.

title: Academic Employee in Coordinated Robotic Shipbuilding
description:
SDU Center for Large Structure Production (LSP), part of the Maersk Mc-Kinney Moller Institute, at University of Southern Denmark (SDU), invites applications for a fully funded position as Academic Employee in the area of model- and simulation-based planning and control of robotic shipbuilding operations (such as hull welding). The position will be vacant from 1 January 2027, or as soon as possible thereafter for a 3-year period – with the possibility of extension. Main work location is Odense/Denmark at SDU and Odense Havn (Odense Port).

Research environment

The candidate will be part of SDU’s newly established Center for Large Structure Production (LSP). LSP’s central ambition is to provide a physical “go-to” lab for companies in the sectors maritime, construction and energy to carry out research, development and testing of novel solutions in the production of large structures, such as buildings, ships and offshore platforms. In this context, the candidate is expected to work closely with our industrial partners on application-oriented use cases, while helping to commission and operate the unique set of equipment of the center. 

LSP is closely working together the companies at Odense Havn and similar partners making large structures across Denmark and Europe. LSP is integrated with the Odense Robotics Cluster involving startups and established companies in robotics. We are a team of currently 17 researchers and engineers, specializing in robot solutions involving modelling, simulation, and control of advanced robot technologies (systems and services) for application-oriented industrial applications. 

Our group is involved in a variety of national and European projects and features a strong network of academic and industrial partners. We solve challenging research problems derived from real-life challenges by implementing novel robot solutions. We value teamwork, professional diligence, enthusiasm for robotics and the drive to adopt new skills and extended responsibilities. We offer an open, international team, with flexible work organization and support of individual development.

Job description

The position as Academic Employee is associated with projects in the sectors maritime, construction and energy. The overall objective of the project is to develop, control and demonstrate LSP’s robotic solutions for executing central production operations, such as welding, 3D concrete printing and composite layup. The main activities in the projects will be industrial R&D tasks carried out by LSP’s engineers in close collaboration with company partners. 

The starting point for the candidate to develop their academic profile in LSP will be to work on so-called “zero programming” methods and tools to define a digital workflow from product design to production operations. Based on analyzing digital product descriptions, the candidate will develop detailed mode-, simulation, and data-based control strategies to carry out the required production operations, including multiple robots, tools, and sensors. Facilitating Digital Twins, these control strategies will then be further developed into control of the physical assets in LSP, i.e. its unique multi-purpose/multi-robot gantry system.

Profile and requirements

The candidate is expected to have most of the following qualifications:

  • Documented education as engineer or technician

  • Documented experience with simulation of industrial robots

  • Strong programming skills (particularly in C/C++ and Python)

  • Ability to work independently as part of an agile team, with a strong sense of responsibility

  • Willingness to engage in application-oriented R&D, by closely interacting with company staff

In close teamwork with our researchers and staff from our industrial partners, the candidate will grow hands-on expertise in robotic production operations, including robots, tools, and sensors. 

Contact information

For further information, please contact Head of Center, Professor Christian Schlette via email (chsch@mmmi.sdu.dk) or on LinkedIn (www.linkedin.com/in/christian-schlette/).

Application deadline: December 2, 2026 at 23:59 o'clock. 

Employment shall take place in accordance with the framework agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

"Salary is determined in accordance with the applicable collective agreement and based on objective and gender-neutral criteria, including the content of the position, responsibilities, and qualification requirements.

As an applicant, you are entitled to information about the starting salary and salary range for the position. This information will be provided during the recruitment process.

SDU does not collect information on applicants’ previous salary.”

Application must include cover letter, CV and certificate. All documents in connection with the application should not contain CPR number (civil registration number) – in that case, the CPR number must be crossed out. 

You can only apply for the position at – https://www.sdu.dk/en/om-sdu/job-sdu. 

All attached files must be in Adobe PDF format. Cover letter and CV can contain max. 5 Mb.

The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

About SDU

The University of Southern Denmark was established to create value for and with society. Whether our contributions come in the form of excellent research, innovative solutions, education or learning, we must make a positive difference to society and contribute to a sustainable future. We do this by cultivating talents and creating the best environments for research and learning. It is therefore crucial that SDU retains, develops and recruits talent. At the same time, we need to ensure consistently high quality in all our activities – and we can only do that with the right people. The University’s researchers, lecturers, students, managers and technical/administrative staff are the foundation of our success.

title: Driftsleder/Supervisor til produktionen i Birkerød
description:

Vi er en dansk scale-up i Nordsjælland, der udvikler, producerer og sælger hampbaserede produkter. Vi arbejder med hele processen fra råvare til færdigt produkt og står overfor at udvide med egne produktionsfaciliteter, så vi kan lancere nye produktkategorier og skalere produktionen.Hverdagen er præget af høje krav til kvalitet, sporbarhed, dokumentation og stabile processer.

Om rollen

Vi søger en supervisor, der kan få den daglige drift i produktionen til at hænge sammen. Du skal skabe overblik på gulvet, følge op på opgaverne og være med til at sikre, at produktionen kører som den skal.

Det er en hands-on rolle, hvor du både deltager i arbejdet og har ansvar for den daglige koordinering i produktionen. Du bliver en vigtig del af teamet under Operationschefen og får en central rolle i at holde flow, kvalitet og fremdrift i hverdagen.

Personaleansvar er ikke et krav, men du skal have erfaring med arbejdsledelse eller daglig supervision i en produktionsvirksomhed.

Dine primære opgaver

  • Sikre den daglige koordinering og arbejdsfordeling i produktionen

  • Følge op på, at opgaver bliver løst korrekt og til tiden

  • Holde overblik over flowet på linjerne og reagere hurtigt ved stop, afvigelser eller flaskehalse

  • Deltage aktivt i produktionen, herunder betjening og overvågning af produktions- og fillingsprocedurer

  • Sikre hygiejne, sporbarhed og dokumentation på batch-niveau

  • Udføre og følge op på in-process-kontroller samt sikre, at kvalitetsdata er opdateret i de digitale systemer

  • Bidrage til orden, rengøring, first-level vedligehold på linjerne

  • Samarbejde tæt med lager og logistik om råvareflow og færdigvareafhentning

  • Være med til at forbedre arbejdsgange og skabe mere struktur i takt med, at produktionen udvikler sig

Din profil

  • Du har erfaring fra fødevare-, kosmetik-, pharma- eller anden procesindustri

  • Du har erfaring med arbejdsledelse, koordinering eller daglig supervision i en produktion

  • Du er vant til at arbejde struktureret og holde overblik i en travl hverdag

  • Du har fokus på kvalitet, renlighed og det at følge procedurer

  • Du kan læse og skrive dansk og/eller engelsk

  • Du er tryg ved at arbejde i digitale systemer og kan lære nye processer og værktøjer

  • Du tager ansvar, når noget skal løses, og bidrager naturligt til, at hverdagen fungerer

Vi tilbyder

  • En central rolle i den daglige drift af produktionen

  • Fast daghold med mulighed for fleks efter aftale

  • Grundig oplæring, inkl. træning i vores principper

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn samt frokostordning, pensionsordning og arbejdsgiverbetalt sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for at vokse i takt med, at vi skalerer nye linjer og automatiserer processer

Send CV og kort motiveret ansøgning til job@chc.dk snarest og senest d. 27. november 2026. Vi indkalder løbende til samtaler. Har du spørgsmål, så ring til 71 99 19 55 eller skriv til km@chc.dk.

Location: Birkerød, North Zealand, Denmark

Recruitment on behalf of our partner company in Birkerød.

We manage the entire process, from raw materials to finished products, and are preparing to expand our operations with our own production facilities. This will allow us to introduce new product categories and increase production capacity.

Our daily operations require high standards of quality, traceability, documentation and process consistency.

We are looking for a Production Supervisor who can help keep our daily production operations running smoothly. You will coordinate work on the production floor, follow up on tasks and help ensure that production runs efficiently and according to plan.

This is a hands-on position, combining active participation in production with responsibility for day-to-day coordination and supervision.

You will work as part of the team reporting to the Head of Operations and play an important role in maintaining production flow, quality and progress.

Formal line management or personnel responsibility is not required, but you must have experience supervising, coordinating or leading daily work in a manufacturing environment.

  • Follow up to ensure tasks are completed correctly and on schedule.

  • Monitor production flow and respond quickly to interruptions, deviations and bottlenecks.

  • Participate directly in production, including operating and monitoring production equipment and filling processes.

  • Perform and follow up on in-process quality checks, ensuring that quality data is accurately recorded in our digital systems.

  • Work closely with warehouse and logistics colleagues to coordinate raw material supply and the movement of finished goods.

  • Help improve workflows and establish more structured processes as production expands.

  • You have previous experience with production-floor supervision, work coordination or day-to-day production leadership.

  • You work in a structured manner and can maintain an overview in a busy production environment.

  • You understand the importance of quality, cleanliness and following established procedures.

  • You can read and write in Danish and/or English.

  • You are comfortable using digital systems and willing to learn new processes and tools.

  • You take responsibility, solve problems when they arise and actively contribute to keeping daily operations running smoothly.

What We Offer

  • An important role in the daily operation and development of our production facilities.

  • Fixed daytime working hours, with flexibility by agreement.

  • Thorough onboarding and training, including training in our operational principles and procedures.

  • Competitive salary, a company lunch scheme, an employer pension scheme and employer-paid private health insurance.

  • Opportunities to develop professionally as we expand production lines and introduce further automation.

Please send your CV and a short cover letter to job@chc.dk as soon as possible and no later than the 27th of November 2026.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis.

If you have any questions about the position, please call +45 71 99 19 55 or email km@chc.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

title: Assistant Professors in Electronic Systems (with the possibility of tenure-track)
description:
At the Technical Faculty of IT and Design, Department of Electronic Systems, one or more positions as Assistant Professor in Electronic Systems are open for appointments from June 1, 2027, or soon after. The positions are full-time and available for a period of 4 years (with the possibility of tenure-track).

Who we areIn electronic engineering, Aalborg University is known worldwide for its high academic quality and societal impact. The Department of Electronic Systems employs more than 200 people, of which about 90 are PhD students, and about 40 % of all employees are internationals. In total, it has more than 700 students in its BSc and MSc programs, which are based on AAU's problem-based learning model.

The department leverages its unique research infrastructure and lab facilities to conduct world-leading fundamental and applied research within one or more of the following areas: communication, networks, control systems, AI, sound, computing, cyber security, quantum technology, and robotics. The department plays an active role in transferring inventions and results into applications in close collaboration with industrial partners worldwide.

The department places significant emphasis on supporting early career researchers and provides comprehensive career and personal development programmes, specifically designed to assist individual academics in achieving their professional objectives.

You can read more about the department at www.es.aau.dk.

Your profile and work tasksWe seek to appoint one or more Assistant Professors (with the possibility of Tenure-Track) to conduct research, teaching, and knowledge exchange, and to grow and develop the department's research activities within our subject fields.The positions require internationally recognized research experience within one or more of the following areas:

• Communication• Networks• Antennas• Control systems• Sound• Artifical intelligence• Signal Processing• Computing• Quantum technology • Robotics

The main tasks and responsibilities include:• developing a research profile and providing valuable contributions to science.• providing research-based teaching and supervision within at least one subject area.• participating in grant application activities• coordinating own projects and contributing to an active academic environment.

Your competenciesYou have an interest in collaborating with external partners and experience from participating in grant applications. You have also contributed to workplace well-being, collaboration, equal treatment, diversity, and a good working environment.Selected candidates should demonstrate development potential in science and have peer-reviewed publications in recognized journals and books or anthologies. Under the leadership of others, you can plan and carry out individual teaching and supervision activities with a focus on the students' learning.

Qualification requirementsApplicants must have academic qualifications at PhD level. The potential of each applicant will be emphasized in the overall assessment

Tenure Track

When appointing tenure track assistant professors, Aalborg University also place particular emphasis on: 

  • The candidate can demonstrate a high degree of autonomy in their previous education and employment path
  • The candidate shows considerable potential and is among the best in their field
  • The candidate has academic experience from several universities and/or research institutions and preferably international experience
  • The candidate is a skilled communicator
  • The candidate writes and speaks English at the academic level
  • The candidate is expected to meet the criteria for permanent employment as an associate professor at Aalborg University at the end of the tenure track process

Assessment in connection with transfer to associate professorshipThe assessment in connection with transition to tenure as an associate professor normally takes place in the final six months of the tenure track assistant professors’ employment. However, the employee may request that an assessment take place at an earlier time in the first four years. If this assessment finds that the employee is not academically qualified, they may request another assessment within the final six months of their period of employment. A maximum of two assessments may take place. 

The assessment, on transition to the associate professorship, will as a minimum, emphasize the following qualifications in relation to the scientific subject area of the tenure track assistant professorship: 

  • Research qualifications equivalent to the level that can be achieved on the basis of satisfactorily completed employment as tenure track assistant professor.
  • Documented scientific production at international level. Assessment will be based on up to ten selected publications selected by the employee.
  • Documentation of pedagogical supervision and upgrading of qualifications, including a positive written assessment of teaching qualifications. The assessment will also be based on the employee's teaching portfolio.
  • The level of contribution to an active academic environment as well as the ability to collaborate and build relationships.
  • The level of experience with grant proposals and experience of communicating research to relevant stakeholders. 

If the tenure track assistant professor fails to request that their qualifications be assessed in the last year of their period of employment or if they are assessed as not academically qualified, the university must immediately initiate dismissal proceedings in accordance with the collective agreement rules. 

How to apply  Your application must include the following: 

  • Application, stating reasons for applying, qualifications in relation to the position, and intentions and visions for the position 
  • Curriculum Vitae (CV) 
  • Diplomas (master's degree diploma and PhD diploma) 
  • List of publications, with an indication of the attached publications that you wish to be taken into account in the assessment. You may attach a maximum of five publications. 
  • Documentation of teaching qualifications.Please see guidelines for teaching portfolio at The Technical Faculty of IT and Design. If this is not enclosed, the applicant must enclose the reasons for this .
  • Dissemination qualifications, including participation on committees or boards, participation in organisations etc. 
  • Additional qualifications in relation to the position 
  • References/recommendations 

You can read more about the requirements for your application here.    

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.  

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position. 

Aalborg University has a policy of parallel language use. The successful applicant is expected, with support from the university, to acquire Danish language skills over time and to be able to contribute to teaching in Danish within 2–5 years of employment, including grading and supervising students, at a level corresponding to the teaching undertaken.

Danish language courses will be offered as part of the employment.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.     

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here   

The appointment process at Aalborg University involves a shortlisting process. You can read more about the shortlisting and appointment process here.  

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace. 

Salary and terms of employment  The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement) and protocol on certain terms of employment of academic staff at universities.

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “Tenure track assistant professor/Tenure track researcher”.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the worldAalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.
