title: Service Line Specialist – SAP (f/d/m) (Sales-Manager/in)
description: Service Line Specialist – EPS SAP, Germany (f/d/m)About the roleAs a Service Line Specialist – EPS SAP, Germany, you will make an impact by driving growth for Cognizant’s SAP services business across new and existing enterprise clients throughout Germany.You will be a valued member of the EPS SAP team and work collaboratively with industry and field sales teams, SAP, hyperscalers and internal solution specialists. You will identify client needs, shape relevant digital transformation solutions and lead opportunities through the end-to-end sales cycle. In this role, you will:- Develop and execute a sales strategy to grow Cognizant’s SAP services business across new and existing enterprise clients in Germany.- Identify, qualify and progress opportunities within a defined portfolio of target accounts, building a sustainable pipeline of SAP transformation engagements.- Lead the end-to-end sales process, from initial client engagement and opportunity qualification through solution development, negotiation and closure.- Achieve annual revenue and total contract value targets for the EPS SAP business.- Collaborate with clients, SAP, hyperscalers, field sales teams and internal stakeholders to translate business requirements into compelling digital solutions.- Build trusted, long-term relationships with senior client stakeholders and clearly communicate Cognizant’s SAP capabilities and value proposition. Work modelWe believe hybrid work is the way forward as we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a hybrid position based in Germany, with regular travel to client sites also required.Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programmes.The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. These may change depending on the project you are engaged in and evolving business or client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations.What you need to have to be considered- Demonstrable sales or business development experience within SAP services, with a track record of selling complex transformation solutions to enterprise clients.- Strong knowledge of the German digital services market, including relevant industry trends, client challenges and opportunities within the SAP ecosystem.- Experience developing target-account plans, building qualified sales pipelines and presenting service offerings and value propositions to senior stakeholders.- A strong understanding of SAP services, ERP market trends, digital transformation and the adoption of intelligent enterprise solutions.- Proven experience leading complex, end-to-end sales cycles involving multiple client, partner and internal stakeholders.- Strong executive communication, relationship-building and commercial negotiation skills.These will help you stand out- Established relationships with enterprise clients and senior decision-makers across Germany.- Experience collaborating directly with SAP and major hyperscalers to shape joint client solutions.- A strong record of achieving annual revenue and total contract value targets for SAP or related enterprise technology services.- Experience working within a global, matrixed consulting or technology services organisation.- Fluency in German and English, with the ability to engage effectively with senior client and internal stakeholders.- A bachelor’s degree in a relevant discipline; an MBA or other advanced qualification would be advantageous. We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Du vernetzt Stadt, Land, Politik, Unternehmen und Bürger:innen. Du bringst Menschen zusammen, stößt neue Projekte an und sorgst dafür, dass Inklusion sichtbar und erlebbar wird.Was machst du bei uns konkret?Du hast viele Freiheiten, eigene Ideen einzubringen und umzusetzen. Dazu gehören:- Projekte entwickeln: Du greifst Ideen aus der Region auf, stößt eigene Projekte an und begleitest deren Umsetzung. Dabei vermittelst du Kontakte und passende Unterstützungsangebote.- Die Zukunft sichern: Du entwickelst Ideen, wie die Modellregion auch über die fünfjährige Förderung hinaus bestehen kann. title: Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d)
description: 1 Teamleitung Fertigung (m/w/d) Arbeitsort: SopronDarum dreht sich Ihre Rolle * Analyse, Vorbereitung und Konzeption ** Sie analysieren die bestehende Fertigung bei unserem bisherigen Lieferanten direkt vor Ort und dokumentieren die Abläufe lückenlos. ** Auf Basis der Daten setzen Sie das bestehende Fertigungskonzept konkret um und bringen sich aktiv in die Feinplanung sowie das Hallenlayout ein, um von Beginn an maximale Effizienz zu sichern. * Prototypenbau, Optimierung und Schnittstellenarbeit ** Sie koordinieren, steuern und unterstützen das Team beim Aufbau des Prototyps auf Basis des zugelieferten Bausatzes. ** Sie analysieren die Effizienz, vervollständigen notwendige Prozessdokumentationen im Dialog mit den Beteiligten und bauen ein System zur Qualitätssicherung in allen Fertigungsschritten auf. ** Sie geben technisches Feedback an das technische Büro zurück und arbeiten eng mit den zentralen Abteilungen (Technik und Projektleitung), der lokalen Geschäfts- und Werksleitung sowie den lokalen Meister:innen zusammen. * Serienüberführung, Arbeitsvorbereitung und Logistik ** Sie bereiten die AV vor, legen Losgrößen für Einzelteile fest und sichern die reibungslose Bereitstellung von Halbzeugen im Standardablauf des neuen Partners. ** Sie erstellen den Fertigungs- und Kapazitätsplan passgenau auf Basis unserer Bestellungen und Liefertermine. ** Sie überführen den Prototypen erfolgreich in die Serienfertigung und wirken parallel an der Entwicklung neuer Prototypen mit. ** Sie tragen die Verantwortung dafür, dass das Endprodukt nach unseren vorgegebenen Standards verpackt und transportiert wird. ** Sie führen und motivieren Ihr Team von 4-10 Personen mit klarem Blick für das gemeinsame Ziel.Diese Kenntnisse können Sie verwerten * Sie verfügen über einen Meistertitel in einem metallverarbeitenden Beruf oder einen HTL-Abschluss mit Matura. Zudem bringen Sie solide handwerkliche Erfahrung und idealerweise bereits Einblicke in die Arbeitsvorbereitung mit. * Sie bringen idealerweise fundierte Praxis aus dem Stahlbau oder der Fertigungstechnologie mit. * Sie haben nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Fertigung komplexer technischer Vorrichtungen sowie in der Serienfertigung. * Sie zeichnen sich durch eine hohe Detailorientierung aus, bringen Ideen konsequent auf die Straße und lassen sich auch von engen Zeitplänen nicht aus der Ruhe bringen. * Da Sie viele Schnittstellen koordinieren, überzeugen Sie durch ausgeprägte Kommunikationsstärke, diplomatisches Geschick und die Fähigkeit, gemeinsame Lösungen zu finden. * Sie haben bereits erste Erfahrung in der Führung von Mitarbeiter:innen gesammelt und verstehen es, Ihr Team zu motivieren und zu inspirieren. * Kenntnisse über Arbeitssicherheit und Arbeitnehmer:innenschutz im modernen Fertigungsumfeld sind für Sie selbstverständlich. * Sichere Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. Da sich die Fertigung vor Ort befinden, sind ungarische Sprachkenntnisse kein Muss, aber ein willkommener Bonus, um die Kommunikation vor Ort noch reibungsloser zu gestalten.Dieses Angebot bereiten wir für Sie vor * Eine abwechslungsreiche Position in einem internationalen Unternehmen, in einem interessanten, rasch wachsenden und innovativen Bereich * Ein engagiertes und dynamisches Team * Firmen-Events * Beteiligung am Unternehmenserfolg * flexible ArbeitszeitenJe nach Qualifikation und Vorerfahrung liegt das Grundgehalt bei dieser Position zwischen EUR 5.000,-- und EUR 6.000,-- brutto monatlich.Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie die Zukunft gemeinsam mit uns!Das AMS Baden wurde durch den Betrieb mit der Vorauswahl betraut.Bitte senden Sie Ihre aussagekräftigen schriftlichen Bewerbungsunterlagen mit folgenden Angaben in der Betreffzeile*U03-17423824*vorzugsweise per Mail an: bewerbung.baden@ams.atBei Mailbewerbungen Speichergröße von 3MB nicht überschreiten!bzw. per Post anAMS Baden * Service für Unternehmen *Nicole Vordre...

title: Senior Software Engineer
description: Fenris Creations is looking for a Senior Software Engineer!The infrastructure team owns the core platform that powers EVE Online, building a reliable foundation that will scale and grow with our players over time. As a senior engineer on the team, you’ll own large, open-ended projects, such as making login faster and safer, letting a node fail without ending a fleet engagement, or finding where the latency in an RPC path goes. You’ll define the problem, propose a direction, split the work into pieces that each ship something useful, and build them with the team, supporting our most critical workloads.Your Tasks:Take a goal like “improve authentication”, talk to the people it affects, and write a design that breaks it into milestones.Lay out the tradeoffs (reliability, cost, effort, risk) and bring the team and stakeholders to an agreement.Write production code, mostly in Go, from service interfaces and data models to the messaging between services, and take your design through review to launch.Estimate throughput, storage and latency before you build, then load test and failure test the result.Work out how state is partitioned, replicated and cached, so a bad node degrades one region while the rest of the cluster keeps running.Explain your designs to engineers and non-technical stakeholders, review other people’s work, and mentor.Your Profile:You push clean, tested code in at least one language, such as Go, Python, Rust, Java, C++, C# or TypeScript. We write mostly in Go and expect you to pick it up quickly if you don’t know it.You break large, ambiguous problems into smaller ones and work through them systematically.You can design a system end to end, with realistic estimates for each component, and explain the tradeoffs.You know data structures and complexity, concurrency, how data stores behave as they grow, and why networks and services fail.You’ve led a project from a fuzzy idea to a shipped result, delivering in increments.You use excellent written and spoken communication skills to communicate and influence technical choices clearly, tailoring trade-offs for each audience.You measure what you build and use the data to choose what comes next.You may lean toward software design or toward how systems fit together, but a blend of both is the perfect sweet spot.Nice to have:Prior hands-on experience with distributed systems patterns: RPC, pub/sub, message queues, event streaming, replication, partitioning.Prior experience running services on AWS, Azure or Kubernetes.Prior exposure to tracing, metrics and structured logging (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Prometheus or similar).Philosophical inclinations towards infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible or similar).Prior experience with enough UNIX and networking (TCP/IP, load balancing) to debug your own systems.A degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent experience.What We Can Offer You:The inspiring opportunity of working on the award winning MMO EVE Online in cooperation with amazingly talented and passionate co-workers.A multicultural work environment that encourages growth, creativity and innovation.Double work station setup and flexible work environment.A lively fun division that hosts regular events.An excellent canteen that offers a weekly breakfast and lunch menu as well as drinks and snacks.Discretionary quarterly and annual performance sharing plan.Annual sports grant.A mobile phone as well as a mobile usage package.Home internet.A conditional monthly transportation grant.Work environment that focuses on employee well-being.On-site doctor, free of charge as well as other on-site services at a discounted price.Relocation Package.Please submit your application in English: https://careers.fenris.com/en/postings/5d2d81e1-174f-4d78-b0cb-ff3a6bd24b4eApplication deadline: Deceember 31st, 2026

title: Ræstingar ofl.
description: Leitað er eftir starfsmanni í hlutastarf við Orlofsbyggðina á Illugastöðum í Fnjóskadal. Starfið felst aðallega í þrifum á orlofshúsum á staðnum sem og afleysingum við þau störf sem til falla hjá Orlofsbyggðinni einnig getur verið um að ræða fullt starf yfir sumartímann. Engrar sérstakrar menntunar er krafist en hæfni og reynsla á þrifum er skilyrði. Ensku kunnátta og lágmarks íslensku kunnátta þarf að vera til staðar. Starfshlutfall getur verið misjafnt á milli mánaða en vinnutími er kl. 9 - 17 þá daga sem unnið er en vinnutími getur þó verið sveigjanlegur upp að vissu marki sé það ósk starfsmanns. Laun eru greidd skv. tímaskráningu hvers mánaðar miðað við launataxta SGS við SA. Starfsmaður þarf almennt ekki að sjá um sig sjálfur til og frá vinnu svo ekki er skilyrði að viðkomandi hafi örkuréttindi eða eigin bíl til umráða en það er vissulega mikill kostur. Ef upp kemur sú staða að starfsmaður komi á eigin vegum / eigin bíl er greiddur akstursstyrkur sem og gjaldið í Vaðlaheiðargöng er greitt fyrir viðkomandi.

title: Senior Raft Guide & Safety Kayaker / Kayak leiðbeinandi
description: Arctic Rafting is looking for a Senior Raft Guide and Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor for the upcoming summer season of 2027. Our season is May – September, with our high season in the summer time; June – August. There are some operations and preparations to do also before and after, in April and October. In particular, we are looking for someone to come in March, to repair equipment and do admin office work for the river operation, to prepare for the summer. This position will extend to be all year round, working part time over the winter months and taking a long leave (1-3 months). Arctic Rafting has a base camp on the well known tourist circuit of “The Golden Circle” in the southern part of Iceland, in just over an hour drive from Reykjavík capital city. Our operations include family friendly rafting trips on the mighty Hvítá River (class II-III), which is the third longest river in Iceland, originating from Langjökull Glacier. Our base camp has other amenities like a bar, restaurant, sauna and hot tubs, so clients can wind down after an action-packed adventure on the river.The qualities we are looking for is experience with good customer service, and good team work skills. Any added language skills are appreciated, operational skills for safe and high quality river trips, repairing skills for river rafting gear and other equipment, and skills for cooking, cleaning, photography, marketing/office, mechanics and general handy man skills. Job description and responsibilities of a Senior Raft Guide:* Operate safe and entertaining river tours for clients (rafting or kayaking)* Be a team leader and trip lead a group of guides in rafting trips of the size of 100+ clients* Kitchen worker and general work in the restaurant and bar serving clients* Work around the property (repair gear, cleaning, laundry, gardening and handy man jobs)Requirements:* Current WRT (Whitewater Rescue Technician) or similar* Current IRF (International Rafting Federation) certification or similar* Up to date Advanced First Aid training* Minimum 5 seasons of raft guide experience* Good English skills to communicate with clientsExtras, good to have, but not a requirement:* A big bus license to drive the river shuttle (45 seater)* Kitchen and bar experience* Photography skills* Sales / marketing skillsWork arrangements:* We generally have one morning trip and one afternoon trip every day; you either do two trips per day, or one trip and then base work for the rest of the day (cooking, cleaning, repair gear, etc.)* The work days can be anything from 4-12 hours per day, but the normality is generally 8-9 hours* A full time job means 160-170 hours per month, and as the hours vary, the pay is by hourly rates* Normally you would get 2 days off per week, but this can vary to 1-3 days off weeklyHousing and food:* Living arrangements is at an old farm in the countryside 1,5 hour from Reykjavík city, next to the river rafting base / restaurant* Everyone gets their own private room, including shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* We do daily communal dinners and everyone is expected to partake in the cooking and cleaning at the end of the day* We supply breakfast, lunch and dinner; while you are at the raft base for work Rates:* Depending on your skill level and experience the pay would be around 2.500 – 2.900isk per hour* In addition to this we offer free housing and food for your stay during your work periodPlease note that in Iceland we pay around 40% tax, and other fees will be deducted too (union, pension fund etc.)Benefits:* Some great times living in the countryside, being a raft guide for an Icelandic summer season* Private room with shared facilities (bathroom with shower)* Use of base facilities (staff kitchen, hot pots and sauna)* Occasional use of communal work car; we strongly recommend having a valid driver’s license, as public transport in Iceland is quite horrid when you live at an old farm in the middle of nowhere.About the Company:This is one of the oldest adventure activities to do in Iceland, but the first river rafting trip with clients was made here in 1985. Around 1990 they started renovations at the old barn and farm house to make the raft base into what it is today; changing rooms, showers, sauna, hot pots, restaurant, bar and guide facilities; for around 10-12 staff members to live there for the summer season. Our clients are mostly from Iceland, Europe and USA, so the minimal language requirements are good English skills. Owned by a local raft guide and kayaker, and more details can be found on our website: www.arcticrafting.com This video sums up what a normal day in the summer looks like – https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQTo apply; please send a CV and cover letter to drumbo@arcticrafting.is before 1st of December 2026Best regards,The Arctic Rafting teamdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.comArctic Rafting leitar að reyndum flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanni (Senior Raft Guide) og öryggiskajakræðara/kajakkennara (Safety Kayaker / Kayak Instructor) fyrir komandi sumartímabil árið 2027.Starfstímabilið okkar er frá maí til september, en háannatíminn er yfir sumarmánuðina, júní til ágúst. Einnig þarf að sinna ýmsum undirbúnings- og rekstrarverkefnum fyrir og eftir tímabilið, í apríl og október.Við leitum sérstaklega að einstaklingi sem getur hafið störf í mars til að sinna viðgerðum á búnaði og skrifstofu- og stjórnsýsluverkefnum tengdum flúðasiglingarekstrinum, til undirbúnings fyrir sumarið.Starfið mun þróast yfir í heilsársstarf, þar sem unnið verður í hlutastarfi yfir vetrarmánuðina og möguleiki verður á lengra leyfi, í 1–3 mánuði.StarfsumhverfiðArctic Rafting er með bækistöð við hina þekktu ferðamannaleið Gullna hringinn á Suðurlandi, í rúmlega klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík.Starfsemin felur meðal annars í sér fjölskylduvænar flúðasiglingaferðir á hinni mikilfenglegu Hvítá (erfiðleikaflokkur II–III). Hvítá er þriðja lengsta á Íslands og á upptök sín við Langjökul.Á bækistöðinni er einnig bar, veitingastaður, gufubað og heitir pottar þar sem gestir geta slakað á eftir ævintýralega ferð niður ána.Eiginleikar sem við leitum aðVið leitum að einstaklingi sem hefur reynslu af góðri þjónustu við viðskiptavini og býr yfir góðri hæfni í teymisvinnu.Önnur tungumálakunnátta er kostur, sem og færni í að skipuleggja og framkvæma öruggar og vandaðar flúðasiglingaferðir.Einnig er kostur að hafa reynslu af viðgerðum á flúðasiglingabúnaði og öðrum tækjum, matreiðslu, þrifum, ljósmyndun, markaðssetningu, skrifstofustörfum, vélaviðgerðum og almennum viðhaldsverkefnum.Starfslýsing og ábyrgð yfirleiðsögumannsStjórna öruggum og skemmtilegum flúðasiglinga- og kajakferðum fyrir viðskiptavini.Vera leiðtogi teymis og stýra hópi leiðsögumanna í flúðasiglingaferðum með yfir 100 þátttakendum.Vinna í eldhúsi og sinna almennum störfum á veitingastað og bar, þar á meðal þjónustu við gesti.Sinna ýmsum verkefnum á svæðinu, svo sem viðgerðum á búnaði, þrifum, þvotti, garðvinnu og almennu viðhaldi.HæfniskröfurGilt WRT-skírteini (Whitewater Rescue Technician – sérhæfð björgun í straumvatni) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild IRF-réttindi (International Rafting Federation – Alþjóðasamband flúðasiglinga) eða sambærileg réttindi.Gild og uppfærð réttindi í ítarlegri skyndihjálp (Advanced First Aid).Að lágmarki fimm tímabils reynsla sem flúðasiglingaleiðsögumaður.Góð enskukunnátta til að eiga samskipti við viðskiptavini.Viðbótarhæfni sem er kostur en ekki skilyrðiÖkuréttindi til að aka stórri rútu (45 farþega) sem notuð er til að flytja gesti til og frá ánni.Reynsla af eldhús- og barstörfum.Hæfni í ljósmyndun.Reynsla af sölu- og markaðsmálum.Vinnutími og starfskjörYfirleitt eru farnar tvær flúðasiglingaferðir á dag, ein að morgni og önnur síðdegis.Starfsmaður fer annaðhvort í tvær ferðir á dag eða eina ferð og sinnir síðan öðrum verkefnum á bækistöðinni, svo sem matreiðslu, þrifum eða viðgerðum á búnaði.Vinnudagar geta verið allt frá 4 upp í 12 klukkustundir, en algengast er að þeir séu um 8–9 klukkustundir.Fullt starf miðast við 160–170 vinnustundir á mánuði. Þar sem vinnustundir eru breytilegar eru laun greidd samkvæmt tímakaupi.Yfirleitt eru tveir frídagar í viku, en þeir geta verið frá einum upp í þrjá eftir aðstæðum.Húsnæði og fæðiStarfsfólk býr á gömlum sveitabæ í um 1,5 klukkustundar akstursfjarlægð frá Reykjavík, við hliðina á flúðasiglingabækistöðinni og veitingastaðnum.Allir starfsmenn fá sérherbergi en deila sameiginlegri aðstöðu, þar á meðal baðherbergi með sturtu.Sameiginlegur kvöldverður er á hverjum degi og ætlast er til að allir taki þátt í matreiðslu og frágangi í lok dags.Boðið er upp á morgunmat, hádegismat og kvöldmat á meðan starfsfólk er við vinnu á bækistöðinni.LaunTímakaup fer eftir hæfni og reynslu viðkomandi og er á bilinu 2.500–2.900 krónur á klukkustund.Auk launa er boðið upp á ókeypis húsnæði og fæði meðan á starfstímabilinu stendur.Athugið að á Íslandi geta skattar numið um 40% af launum og að önnur gjöld eru einnig dregin frá, svo sem stéttarfélagsgjöld og lífeyrissjóðsiðgjöld.FríðindiEinstakt tækifæri til að upplifa íslenskt sumar í sveitinni og starfa við flúðasiglingar.Sérherbergi með sameiginlegri baðaðstöðu.Aðgangur að aðstöðu á bækistöðinni, þar á meðal starfsmannaeldhúsi, heitum pottum og gufubaði.Stundum er hægt að nýta sameiginlegan starfsmannabíl.Við mælum eindregið með því að umsækjendur hafi gilt ökuskírteini, þar sem almenningssamgöngur á Íslandi eru afar takmarkaðar þegar búið er á gömlum sveitabæ úti í sveit.Um fyrirtækiðFlúðasiglingar eru ein elsta skipulagða ævintýraafþreying sem boðið hefur verið upp á á Íslandi. Fyrsta flúðasiglingaferðin með viðskiptavini á þessu svæði var farin árið 1985.Um 1990 hófst endurnýjun á gamla fjósinu og íbúðarhúsinu á bænum með það að markmiði að útbúa þá aðstöðu sem þar er í dag.Þar er nú að finna búningsklefa, sturtur, gufubað, heita potta, veitingastað, bar og aðstöðu fyrir leiðsögumenn. Á sumrin er aðstaða fyrir um 10–12 starfsmenn til að búa á staðnum.Viðskiptavinir okkar koma að mestu leyti frá Íslandi, Evrópu og Bandaríkjunum og því er góð enskukunnátta lágmarkskrafa.Fyrirtækið er í eigu flúðasiglingaleiðsögumanns og kajakræðara úr heimabyggð.Nánari upplýsingar um fyrirtækið má finna á vefsíðunni:www.arcticrafting.comMyndband sem sýnir dæmigerðan sumardag hjá Arctic Rafting:https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6OXFlZTrEzQUmsóknir:Áhugasamir eru beðnir um að senda ferilskrá og kynningarbréf á netfangið:drumbo@arcticrafting.isUmsóknarfrestur er til 1. desember 2026.Með bestu kveðju,Starfsfólk Arctic Raftingdrumbo@arcticrafting.iswww.arcticrafting.is / www.arcticrafting.com

title: Census Field Support Officer
description: The Census Field Support Officer (previously known as Census Enumerator) is a key member of the Census 2027 field staff team. As a Census Field Support Officer, you will work in or near your local area. Between 5 April and 9 May, you will be calling to homes to let people know about Census 2027 and to offer help and support. After 9 May, you will follow up with the homes in your area which have not completed a census form.You may be required to engage with local groups in your area to help them to understand the census and what they need to do to complete their census forms, along with other census field staff.You should be physically fit as you will be responsible for between 450-850 homes. In some cases, you may be required to make repeat visits to homes to ensure that the householder is aware of and supported to take part in the census.A mobile phone will be provided with a census field app to show you the map of your area and the list of homes to visit. You will record your visits and other details on the mobile phone app. If a household completes their census online, it will automatically be removed from your visit list.You will report to a Census Field Supervisor who will manage a team of census field support officers. Training will be provided and there will be regular contact and support to help you in your role.Census 2027 will take place between 5 April and 9 May 2027. For the first time, people will be able to choose between completing their census form online or on paper. There will be a five-week period (5 April to 9 May) to complete census forms, rather than one census night. Some 3,850 Census Field Support Officers will work on Census 2027 in every part of Ireland. The Census Field Support Officer job is 18 hours per week (mainly evenings and weekends) and is an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May. The rate of pay for the full duration will be over €3,000 plus an allowance. Candidates must be over 18 years of age.

Here at PHX Ireland, we strive to be a place for everyone - where each and every one of us can be our true, authentic selves, every single day.  For us, individuality sparks new ideas, shapes new approaches and brings us powerful new perspectives. It’s the heartbeat of our innovation, creativity, and success. We are founded on values of compassionate care, advice you can trust, speedy service and excellent value for money. The patient and customer are truly at the heart of what we do. The teams that serve our customers are central to our organisation. Our commitment to our staff is to enable them to develop their careers and to have as many opportunities to be the best they can be. We support our team with continuing education, great working conditions, flexibility and good incentives and benefits and a fun loving working environment. If you think you could flourish along side us, please apply.   About PHX Ireland & PHOENIX Group    PHX Ireland Group is Ireland’s leading fully integrated healthcare provider. We deliver health. We are comprised of United Drug, Ireland’s leading pharmaceutical wholesaler and distributor; McCabes Pharmacy, Ireland’s leading community pharmacy chain; and TCP Homecare, innovators in clinical home nursing services and direct to patient delivery solutions. PHX Ireland Group employs over 1,800 people, operates 5 distribution centres and pharmacies nationwide, delivering over 85 million packs to Irish pharmacies and hospitals and serving 500,000 patients each year. By working together to provide these solutions, PHX Ireland can enable a sustainable healthcare system and support Irish Healthcare. PHX Ireland is part of the PHOENIX group, Europe’s leading healthcare provider. Headquartered in Mannheim, Germany, the PHOENIX group brings together more than 48,000 employees from 29 countries, includes 223 pharmaceutical distribution sites, and more than 3200 owned pharmacies and 17000 partner pharmacies. Every day, the PHOENIX group makes an important contribution to comprehensive and safe healthcare in Europe. We strive to foster an open and inclusive environment, embracing applications from individuals of all backgrounds. Our commitment lies in ensuring an accessible interview process for all candidates. If you require additional support or accommodations to attend an interview, we kindly encourage you to reach out to jobs@mccabespharmacy.ie

title: Census Field Support Officer
description: The Census Field Support Officer (previously known as Census Enumerator) is a key member of the Census 2027 field staff team. As a Census Field Support Officer, you will work in or near your local area. Between 5 April and 9 May, you will be calling to homes to let people know about Census 2027 and to offer help and support. After 9 May, you will follow up with the homes in your area which have not completed a census form.You may be required to engage with local groups in your area to help them to understand the census and what they need to do to complete their census forms, along with other census field staff.You should be physically fit as you will be responsible for between 450-850 homes. You will record your visits and other details on the mobile phone app. If a household completes their census online, it will automatically be removed from your visit list.You will report to a Census Field Supervisor who will manage a team of census field support officers. Training will be provided and there will be regular contact and support to help you in your role.Census 2027 will take place between 5 April and 9 May 2027. For the first time, people will be able to choose between completing their census form online or on paper. There will be a five-week period (5 April to 9 May) to complete census forms, rather than one census night. Some 3,850 Census Field Support Officers will work on Census 2027 in every part of Ireland. The Census Field Support Officer job is 18 hours per week (mainly evenings and weekends) and is an eight-week contract from 5 April to 28 May. The rate of pay for the full duration will be over €3,000 plus an allowance. Candidates must be over 18 years of age.

description: We are partnering with a prominent industry-leading client to find a STRATEGIC BUYER with a primary focus on steel and metal components. Location: Italy (with frequent interaction across the Group's operations in Italy -Padova and Imperia- and Germany) The successful candidate will be responsible for developing and implementing sourcing strategies for key direct material categories, with a primary focus on steel and metal components, followed by electric motors, plastics and fasteners. This is a highly visible role with a significant impact on the Group's profitability through cost reduction initiatives, supplier development, volume aggregation and strategic sourcing projects across our Italian and German operations. Key Responsibilities Strategic Sourcing & Category Management - Develop and execute sourcing strategies for assigned commodity categories. - Manage RFQs, tenders and supplier negotiations at both local and international levels. - Analyze commodity markets, industry trends and key cost drivers. - Build and maintain a robust pipeline of cost-saving initiatives. - Drive supplier competitiveness while ensuring quality and supply continuity. Group Synergies & Volume Leverage - Identify opportunities to aggregate purchasing volumes across Group companies. - Negotiate framework agreements, volume rebates, index-based pricing mechanisms and commercial terms. - Lead supplier consolidation and standardization initiatives. - Support make-or-buy decisions, localization projects and low-cost-country sourcing strategies. - Harmonize supplier terms, payment conditions and Incoterms across the Group where appropriate. Supplier Development & Management - Develop strategic relationships with key suppliers. - Lead supplier scouting, qualification and onboarding activities. - Identify and implement alternative sourcing solutions to reduce supply chain risks. - Manage supplier performance and continuous improvement programs. - Collaborate closely with Quality, Engineering, Operations and Finance teams. Cost Optimization & Value Engineering - Partner with Engineering and Operations on: o Value Analysis / Value Engineering (VA/VE) o Product standardization o Specification optimization o Target costing initiatives o Localization projects - Challenge supplier quotations through market benchmarking and should-cost analysis. - Drive sustainable cost reduction and productivity initiatives. Reporting & Performance Monitoring - Track spend, savings and procurement KPIs. - Develop and maintain procurement dashboards using Excel and Power BI. - Report sourcing activities, savings projects and supply risks to senior management. - Ensure appropriate contract coverage and procurement governance. What We Are Looking For Essential Requirements - Minimum 7/10 years of experience in strategic procurement of direct materials within a manufacturing environment. - Strong experience in: o Steel purchasing o Metal fabrication sourcing o Commodity management - Proven track record in international procurement and global sourcing. - Solid understanding of: o Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) o Cost breakdown analysis o Incoterms o Contract negotiation o Cross-border supply risks - Fluent English and Italian both written and spoken. - Advanced Excel skills and experience with Power BI or similar analytical tools. Preferred Qualifications - Experience sourcing electric motors, gear motors, plastics or industrial components. - Previous experience working in multinational and multi-site industrial organizations. Key Competencies Strategic Negotiation You understand supplier economics, create competitive tension and secure long-term commercial value through effective negotiations. Analytical Mindset You leverage spend analysis, cost models, market intelligence and data-driven decision making to identify opportunities and support strategic initiatives. Category Management You can build and execute sourcing strategies, supplier roadmaps and multi-year savings plans. Collaboration & Influence You effectively engage stakeholders across Procurement, Engineering, Operations, Quality and Finance, driving alignment across multiple sites and countries. Results Orientation You are passionate about delivering measurable savings, improving procurement performance and creating business value. What We Offer - A strategic role with high visibility within an international industrial group. - The opportunity to influence procurement strategy and business performance at a Group level. - Exposure to international sourcing projects and cross-functional initiatives. - A dynamic and collaborative work environment. - Opportunities for professional growth and career development. - Full remote working - Salary range: 70-80K Euro - Benefits: company Car - Availability to travel approximately 60% of working time, including regular visits to suppliers and frequent travel to the Group's sites in Padua, Imperia and Horstmar, with travel frequency varying according to business needs and project requirements. title: supervisore dei cantieri edili
description: Per solida realtà operante nell'industria edile, siamo alla ricerca di un/a Responsabile di Commessa. La persona avrà la responsabilità di seguire la commessa 'end-to-end' sul campo, garantendo che attività, squadre e fornitori lavorino in modo coordinato, mantenendo una relazione efficace con il cliente. Obiettivo del ruolo Gestire operativamente una o più commesse assicurando l'avanzamento regolare dei lavori e un controllo puntuale su programmazione, risorse, varianti, consegne e marginalità, con approccio pratico e orientamento al risultato. Attività principali Programmare commesse e cantieri: pianificare l'alternanza dei lavori nel medio-lungo periodo in funzione di scadenze contrattuali e durata dei cantieri. Organizzare le attività di apertura del cantiere fino alla chiusura, definendo attività giornaliere e settimanali, monitorando lo stato avanzamento lavori. Gestire operatività, standard e comportamenti, lavorando su efficienza, metodo e rispetto delle procedure con squadre e subappaltatori. Raccogliere esigenze e gestire criticità in modo concreto (es. ripianificazione dell'ordine di montaggio senza perdere il controllo su tempi e costi). Controllo tempi/contratti/spedizioni: presidiare consegne, vincoli contrattuali, varianti ed extra, assicurando coerenza tra accordi e operatività. Controllo economico di commessa: supportare stime e consuntivi, contribuendo alla tutela della marginalità e alla gestione economica. Collaborazione con uffici interni (tecnico, produzione, logistica) per garantire la continuità delle attività e il corretto flusso di arrivo dei materiali sui cantieri. Requisiti Laurea in Ingegneria/Architettura o Diploma di Geometra (o titolo tecnico equivalente). Esperienza indicativa di ~10 anni su cantieri industriali con ruoli di responsabilità (capocantiere / responsabile operativo / responsabile di commessa). Capacità di pianificazione, gestione priorità, avanzamento lavori e controllo economico. Disponibilità a trasferte sui cantieri (Italia settentrionale) Leadership 'sul campo', attenzione a regole, sicurezza e metodi di lavoro. Ottime doti relazionali: comunicazione chiara, negoziazione e problem solving. Affidabilità, pragmatismo e forte orientamento a tempi e consegne. title: tecnico della gestione post vendita
description: Per conto di una primaria realtà internazionale leader nei servizi Food & Retail, presente con una rete capillare di punti vendita in aeroporti, stazioni ferroviarie e aree di servizio, siamo alla ricerca di un/una Retail Expansion Specialist. La risorsa entrerà a far parte del team dedicato allo sviluppo della rete e avrà la responsabilità di identificare, valutare e supportare nuove opportunità di espansione commerciale. Operando come punto di raccordo tra funzioni interne ed interlocutori esterni, supporterà l'intero iter di sviluppo delle opportunità, dalla fase di scouting e analisi economica fino alla formalizzazione degli accordi. Principali responsabilità: Analizzare e monitorare opportunità di sviluppo e ampliamento del network retail sul territorio italiano. Effettuare valutazioni economico-finanziarie e business case relativi a nuove aperture, rinnovi contrattuali e progetti di sviluppo. Supportare la gestione delle trattative e delle negoziazioni con proprietari immobiliari, enti pubblici e stakeholder coinvolti. Collaborare con i team Legal, Finance, Real Estate e Operations per garantire la corretta esecuzione dei progetti. Analizzare bandi di gara, convenzioni, contratti di locazione e documentazione correlata. Predisporre presentazioni, report e analisi a supporto delle decisioni di investimento. Gestire relazioni efficaci con interlocutori interni ed esterni, favorendo l'allineamento degli interessi delle diverse parti coinvolte. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Amministrazione Aziendale o discipline affini. Esperienza di almeno 3 anni in ruoli legati a sviluppo immobiliare, retail expansion, real estate, business development o analisi investimenti. Solida capacità di lettura e interpretazione di dati economico-finanziari e KPI di business. Buona familiarità con contratti, clausole commerciali e documentazione legale correlata alle attività di sviluppo. Ottima conoscenza di Excel e degli strumenti di analisi economica. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il Profilo Forte orientamento al risultato e al raggiungimento degli obiettivi. Spiccate doti di negoziazione e mediazione. Capacità di influenzare positivamente stakeholder interni ed esterni. Attitudine alla costruzione e gestione di relazioni professionali di lungo periodo. Approccio pragmatico, autonomia e capacità di gestire progetti complessi. Interesse per il settore retail, travel retail e sviluppo di reti commerciali. Cosa offre l'azienda: Inserimento in una realtà internazionale solida e in costante crescita. Opportunità di contribuire direttamente ai progetti di espansione del business. Ambiente dinamico, sfidante e altamente collaborativo. Smart working strutturato. Percorsi di sviluppo professionale e crescita interna. RAL compresa tra €47.000 e €52.000, commisurata all'esperienza maturata e sistema premiante. description: La Divisione Permanent Consultant di Gi Group seleziona, per azienda leader mondiale nella progettazione e produzione di soluzioni in resina e materiale plastico per l'organizzazione degli spazi domestici, il lavoro e l'outdoor, un/a CAPO TURNO DI PRODUZIONE. La risorsa, inserita all'interno del reparto produttivo e a riporto del Responsabile di Produzione / Direzione Operations, avrà la responsabilità di coordinare il turno e supervisionare il team di operatori, garantendo efficienza, sicurezza e qualità. Si occuperà inoltre della rendicontazione e del corretto passaggio di consegne tra i turni. Di cosa ti dovrai occupare? Supervisione reparto: coordinamento delle risorse assegnate al turno e controllo di ordine, pulizia e rispetto delle norme di sicurezza (D.Lgs. 81/08) dell'area produttiva. Supporto tecnico-operativo: affiancamento agli operatori sulle linee automatizzate (stampaggio a iniezione/assemblaggio), verifica delle attrezzature, dei materiali e del corretto utilizzo dei DPI. Gestione cambio produzione e stampi: supporto e supervisione nelle fasi di attrezzaggio, avvio linea e cambio stampo per ridurre i tempi di fermo macchina. Monitoraggio produzione: verifica dell'avanzamento rispetto ai piani produttivi, controllo dei KPI di reparto (OEE, scarti) e gestione delle priorità operative. Gestione criticità: primo intervento in caso di anomalie o rallentamenti sugli impianti, interfacciandosi con la manutenzione e il controllo qualità per applicare azioni correttive. Controlli e reporting: compilazione della modulistica di turno, verifica dei parametri di processo e comunicazione dell'andamento giornaliero ai superiori. Passaggio consegne: trasferimento puntuale delle informazioni tecniche e organizzative al capo turno subentrante. Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Esperienza pregressa nel ruolo di capoturno o caporeparto in contesti industriali strutturati (preferibilmente nel settore dello stampaggio materie plastiche o manifatturiero automatizzato). Leadership e gestione team: autorevolezza nel far rispettare le regole, equilibrio relazionale, visione d'insieme e attenzione alle criticità. Autonomia organizzativa: capacità di gestire imprevisti, stress e definire le priorità operative. Orientamento al miglioramento continuo: conoscenza base delle logiche Lean Manufacturing e collaborazione nella ricerca di soluzioni. Ordine e pulizia come standard di lavoro. Informatica di base: utilizzo PC, applicativi d'ufficio e sistemi gestionali di produzione (MES/ERP). Requisiti preferenziali Diploma ad indirizzo tecnico (meccanico, elettrotecnico, chimico o affine). Esperienza specifica nello stampaggio a iniezione. Patentino per il carrello elevatore. description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; title: ingegnere meccanico
description: Grafton Engineering is a team dedicated to enhancing the experience, skills and potential of candidates in Design, Logistics & Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Quality - Safety & Environment, Process & Project Management. Saipem Spa is a global leader in engineering and construction for the energy and infrastructure sectors, delivering complex onshore and offshore projects worldwide. Driven by technological innovation as 'One Company', our 30,000 people from over 130 nationalities in more than 50 countries work every day to enable the energy transition toward Net Zero. At Saipem, we embrace diversity as a driver of innovation and inclusion, while prioritizing people's safety and environmental sustainability, even in the most challenging conditions. As Maintenance Engineering Specialist you will respond to the Maintenance Engineering Lead and be part of the Energy Carriers Business Line within EPC Maintenance and Inspection Engineering Department. Job includes plant reliability analysis, equipment criticality assessment and maintenance plan development. Scope of the work involves activities ranging from acknowledging of process-related conditions and evaluating the equipment detail design. Maintenance Engineering Specialist (MES) is to make sure that the project detailed design is safe and sound from an operation and maintenance point of view, complies with the international standards and meet the requirements arising from contract and technical specification therein referred to. In performing his job, the MES is liaising with client representatives, partners, suppliers and project team. MES regularly reports to the Commissioning, Operation and Maintenance manager the status of the Maintenance Engineering assessment, highlighting areas of concern. How can you support us? supporting the maintenance engineering lead in reviewing the project technical documentation in respect to the contractual requirements, gathering of maintenance related design data from technical disciplines and vendors to build-up a comprehensive plant asset register which includes all the maintainable equipment, preparation of Maintainable Equipment List (MEL) hierarchically organized by functional location which in turn refer to physical asset; operability and maintainability review, support mechanical handling assessment, equipment criticality analysis (ECA) to rank item listed in MEL in view of safety, environment and production requirement, maintenance strategies, procedures, and tasks according to either the original equipment manufacturer data or the results of the performed Reliability Centered Maintenance (RCM) analysis; operational performance standard preparation; CMMS loading templates preparation Education: Master's Degree/bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering or similar qualification Experience: 5+ years of experience in the Oil & Gas industry Languages: English level B2/C1 What else should you know? Some travelling will be expected within EMEA, Africa, etc What we can offer to you: Permanent Contract, CCNL Energia e Petrolio For home office contract: Pay not lower than 43000€ Corporate Benefits: We offer a comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, internal gym, discounts and partnerships, services related to health, family, well-being, and in-house cafeteria. Hybrid working model: Smart Working options and flexible hours to help you achieve a better work-life balance. title: To stipendiatstillingar ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze
employer: UNIVERSITETET I BERGEN DET HUMANISTISKE FAKULTET
description:
Stipendiat

Det er ledig to stipendiatstillingar (100%) ved European University Institute (EUI) i Firenze. Oppstart i stillingane i september 2027. Stillingane er ledig for ein periode på tre (3) år, med moglegheit for stipend for eit fjerde år. 

Stillingane er finansierte av det norske kunnskapsdepartementet. Stipendiatane vert teken opp i eit av ph.d.-programma ved EUI, med Universitetet i Bergen som arbeidsgjevar.

Om EUI og ph.d.-programma

European University Institute er eit europeisk forskingsuniversitet innan humaniora og samfunnsvitskap som ligg i Firenze i Italia. EUI har ph.d.-program innan historie, økonomi, samfunnsvitskap og rettsvitskap. Stipendiatane knytt til ph.d.-programma kjem frå 25 ulike europeiske land. Gruppa med stipendiatar er organisert i kull, med samtidig oppstart kvar haust. 

Søkjarane som får tilbod om stipendiatstilling, får opptak til eitt av dei fire ph.d.-programma. 

Ph.d.-utdanninga er normert til fire år.

Meir informasjon om EUI, programma og søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes

Kvalifikasjonar og krav:
  • Søkjaren må vere norsk statsborgar eller ha permanent opphaldsløyve i Noreg.
  • Søkjaren må ha mastergrad eller tilsvarande grad. 
  • Søkjarar som har fullført doktorgrad, kan ikkje bli tilsette i stipendiatstilling innan det same fagområdet.
  • Det er EUI som vurderer om fagbakgrunnen til dei som søkjer opptak er relevant for det einskilde ph.d.-program.
Løn og andre vilkår:
  • Løn som stipendiat, som for tida svarar til ei brutto årsløn på NOK 593.700.
  • Etableringsstipend det første året etter satsane til forskingsrådet: NOK 300 000 for enkeltperson og NOK 516 000 ved familie
  • Driftsmidlar: NOK 50 000 pr år
  • Stipend det fjerde året. Opptak til det fjerde året må stipendiaten søkja EUI om. Ved innvilga opptak vert det gjeve stipend frå EUI og UiB.
Slik søkjer du stillinga:

Lenke til EUI sitt søknadsskjema finn du her: Doctoral Programmes.

Informasjon om faglege krav i søknaden, innhald i programmet og arbeidskvardagen kan ein få ved å sjå på «FAQs and Contacts» under det einskilde program. 

Generell informasjon:

Informasjon om arbeidsforholdet til UiB og UiB si forvaltning av avtalen kan ein få ved å kontakte: 

Seniorrådgiver Yngve Brynjulfsen, yngve.brynjulfsen@uib.no, 

+47 55 58 33 82 

    

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Universitetet i Bergen er ein anerkjend utdannings- og forskingsinstitusjon, organisert i sju fakultet og omlag 54 institutt og faglege senter. Campus ligg i sentrale delar av Bergen med universitetsområde på Nygårdshøyden, Haukeland, Marineholmen, Møllendalsveien og Årstad.

Det humanistiske fakultet består av fire institutt og fire senter. Les meir om fakultet og tilhøyrande institutt.

title: Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer  (SST) (f/m/div) (Ingenieur/in - Mikroelektronik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life. Turning customer whispers into industry-shaking solutions... ready to amplify the future?As a Principal System Applications Engineer Solid State Transformer (SST) on our Customer Collaboration and Technical Marketing team work hand-in-hand with our customers, enabling them to transform our products into cutting-edge designs, all while building long-lasting partnerships that thrive on success.Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Engage with leading customers to understand SST architectures, requirements, and technical challenges, translating them into semiconductor and subsystem solutions.- Develop and validate application solutions through simulation, prototyping, measurements, benchmarking, and troubleshooting.- Create technical proof points using PoCs, demonstrators, and experimental validation, including collaboration with external partners.- Convert engineering results into customer-ready technical materials, such as design recommendations, BOM guidance, simulation models, and training content. - Enable Field Application Engineers (FAEs) and regional teams through technical training, workshops, and support for complex customer engagements.- Support strategic customer projects and design-ins, working with customers and internal experts to solve system-level application challenges.Your profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - Master’s degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related field, combined with 6+ years of industry experience in power electronics, power conversion, or application engineering.- Possess strong expertise in power converter topologies and power semiconductor technologies, with experience in Solid-State Transformers (SSTs), medium-voltage systems, modular converters, or multilevel converters considered a plus.- Demonstrate a broad system-level understanding of gate driving, control, protection, sensing, magnetics, thermal management, and reliability.- Apply hands-on experience in simulation, hardware development, commissioning, measurement, and troubleshooting to develop and validate engineering solutions.- Translate system requirements into practical semiconductor and subsystem recommendations, balancing technical performance and application needs.- Thrive in global, cross-functional environments, showing strong ownership, collaboration, and the ability to influence and drive topics independently across regions, divisions, customers, and external partners.Salary pay information:AustriaAt Infineon in Villach you shape the technologies of tomorrow and work in an international environment with more than 4.700 colleagues from over 70 nations. Your personal contribution will be valued and appreciated as the cornerstones of our success. And all that in beautiful surroundings which guarantee a high quality of life.The City of Villach is located in the center of Carinthia, Austria’s southernmost province, in close proximity to the Italian and Slovenian border. Due to its particular geographic location and the outstanding natural beauty of the region, Villach and the whole province of Carinthia have for generations been popular holiday destinations for people from all over the world. Living in Austria also has many social, health-care-related and economic perks. The country’s social and health care system is among the best in the world and for decades numerous international surveys have singled out Austria as a particularly safe and wealthy country with a high quality of life. Villach benefits from its status as a “small town”, offering everyday living at affordable prices in an outstanding setting.We offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group I,J* (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.ItalyLocationIndicative salary rangeMilan, Italy*€63360 – €87120*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

title: dirigente delle risorse umane
description: Direttore Generale Azienda di servizi SW & HW - Information Technology | Piccola Impresa Wyser ricerca un Direttore Generale per una PI (piccola impresa) italiana a proprietà imprenditoriale, attiva nell'erogazione di servizi SW&HW ICT a imprese ed enti pubblici. L'azienda offre soluzioni SW & HW per infrastrutture e reti, cloud, cybersecurity e assistenza IT, integrate con fornitura e noleggio di tecnologie hardware e software. Si distingue per la relazione continuativa con i clienti e per un approccio da boutique orientato alla qualità del servizio. Il ruolo Il Direttore Generale affiancherà la proprietà nella definizione e nell'attuazione della strategia aziendale, assumendo la responsabilità del coordinamento complessivo delle attività e del raggiungimento degli obiettivi concordati. Contribuirà al rafforzamento dell'organizzazione e all'evoluzione dell'offerta, con attenzione alla redditività, all'innovazione tecnologica e allo sviluppo delle persone. Principali responsabilità Definire con la proprietà il piano di sviluppo aziendale e tradurlo in obiettivi, budget e priorità operative, monitorandone l'attuazione e proponendo eventuali azioni correttive. Migliorare il modello organizzativo, i processi e gli strumenti di pianificazione e controllo, introducendo responsabilità chiare e indicatori di performance a supporto delle decisioni. Presidiare i risultati economici e gestionali, in collaborazione con la funzione amministrativa, attraverso l'analisi di ricavi, costi, marginalità di progetti e servizi, investimenti e impiego delle risorse. Coordinare le funzioni commerciali, tecniche e operative, assicurando coerenza tra obiettivi di vendita, capacità di erogazione e qualità del servizio al cliente. Sviluppare il business consolidando le relazioni con i clienti strategici, individuando nuove opportunità e favorendo una maggiore integrazione dell'offerta per imprese ed enti pubblici. Guidare l'evoluzione del portafoglio di soluzioni e servizi, valutando tecnologie emergenti e applicazioni dell'intelligenza artificiale in funzione delle esigenze del mercato e del ritorno economico. Valorizzare e sviluppare le competenze dei collaboratori, promuovendo collaborazione tra team, responsabilizzazione e condivisione delle conoscenze. Gestire e sviluppare le relazioni con vendor e partner strategici, collaborando con le funzioni competenti al presidio della qualità, della sicurezza delle informazioni e della compliance. Requisiti e competenze Esperienza in ruoli di direzione generale, direzione di business unit o responsabilità manageriale trasversale nel settore dei servizi, preferibilmente presso system integrator o provider di servizi IT, in alternativa altri servizi B2B es. Digital, TLC... Responsabilità maturata nella gestione di risultati economici, budget e team, con capacità di integrare visione strategica ed esecuzione operativa. Conoscenza del mercato ICT e dei modelli di business legati a progetti, servizi ricorrenti e soluzioni tecnologiche; capacità di valutarne marginalità, complessità operativa e potenziale di sviluppo. Preparazione tecnologica adeguata a confrontarsi con gli specialisti su infrastrutture, networking, cloud e cybersecurity e a orientare le scelte di offerta e investimento. Esperienza nel miglioramento di processi e organizzazione, con capacità di introdurre metodi e strumenti gestionali proporzionati alle esigenze di una piccola impresa. Capacità di costruire un rapporto di fiducia con la proprietà, condividere le priorità e rendicontare con chiarezza risultati, criticità e proposte. Costituiranno elementi preferenziali l'esperienza in contesti imprenditoriali o familiari e la partecipazione a percorsi di evoluzione manageriale. Saranno valorizzate anche la conoscenza del mercato pubblico e dei modelli di noleggio tecnologico. La ricerca è aperta anche a figure provenienti da ruoli di direzione Sales & Delivery, Operations o Commerciale, purché abbiano maturato responsabilità effettive su organizzazione, persone e risultati economici, oltre allo sviluppo delle vendite. Lo stile manageriale Cerchiamo una persona autorevole e concreta, capace di ascoltare, comprendere il contesto e accompagnare il cambiamento in modo costruttivo. Saranno centrali la capacità di coinvolgere collaboratori esperti, prendere decisioni e tradurre le opportunità tecnologiche in iniziative sostenibili per il business. L'opportunità professionale Il ruolo offre la possibilità di contribuire direttamente alla direzione e all'evoluzione di una piccola impresa ICT, lavorando a stretto contatto con la proprietà e incidendo sulle scelte organizzative, commerciali e tecnologiche. Il progetto valorizza una figura manageriale capace di coniugare sviluppo del business, qualità del servizio e continuità delle relazioni con clienti e collaboratori. title: Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) - HRC1792713 (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
description: #WeAreIn for jobs that impact everyone's life.Driving continuous improvement - ready to make quality a culture?As a Principle Engineer for early failure mechanisms, methodologies and tools (f/m/div) in our Quality & Excellence team uncover the root causes behind every single error, drive transformational improvements, and implement forward-thinking solutions to ensure our products exceed the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance. Are you in?Your roleKey responsibilities in your new role- Act as the technical lead and methodological expert for Burn-in (BI), including steering BI decisions, driving continuous improvements, and serving as the primary interface to technology and product development as well as statistics teams- Provide teaching, coaching, and knowledge transfer on Burn-in topics to cross-functional teams, ensuring a consistent and high-quality understanding of BI methodologies across the organization- Support Design for Stress (DfS) sustaining activities, including the management and resolution of DfS Jira Tickets in close collaboration with relevant stakeholders- Serve as the 1st level of support for internal customer inquiries, with a particular focus on** Automotive Governance**, ensuring timely and solution-oriented responses- Drive long-term, strategically important tasks that require sustained attention, ensuring that critical but non-urgent topics receive appropriate prioritization and follow-through- Collaborate closely with Front-End (FE), Back-End (BE) and product development teams, contributing expert knowledge on failure mechanisms, defects, design and test conditions to support informed quality decisions- Lead customer communications about early topics- Contribute to the continuous improvement of Quality Management Systems (QMS), processes, methods, and tools along the entire supply chain, with a strong automotive quality mindsetYour profileQualifications and skills to help you succeed - A degree in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Materials Science, Physics, or a related field- At least 6 years of professional work experience in semiconductor manufacturing, with a strong focus on quality management along the supply chain, Front-End and Back-End processes, and reliability testing- Expert-level knowledge in Burn-in methodologies, including deep understanding of physical failure mechanisms, defect analysis, Fault Analysis (FA), and test conditions relevant to semiconductor devices- Proven experience as a technical lead in a cross-functional environment, with the ability to drive decisions, align stakeholders, and manage Design for Stress (DfS) activities effectively- Solid understanding of wafer manufacturing process, foundational skills in data analysis, and familiarity with chip design, test engineering and product development processes- Proficiency in digital collaboration tools such as Confluence, Jira, and Intranet platforms- Show a strong automotive quality mindset and knowledge about automotive requirements- Outstanding interpersonal skills and a genuine service provider attitude, with demonstrated ability to coach, teach, and inspire colleagues while fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture- Fluent English (written and spoken); German is a plusPlease send us your CV in EnglishPlease note that:- Subject to meeting all job requirements, belonging to protected categories under Law 68/69 will be considered a preferential requirementAdditional information by locationAustriaWe offer competitive salaries and additional benefits based on your performance, experience, and qualification. The employment is in accordance with the collective salary and wage agreement for employees of the electrical and electronics industry, employment group H,I (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/ (https://www.feei.at/aktuelles/mindestloehne-und-gehaelter-eei/) ). The monthly salary is paid 14 times p.a. We offer a higher compensation depending on your expertise and skills.Salary pay information:In line with local legal requirements, indicative salary ranges are disclosed for selected locations where applicable.LocationIndicative salary rangePadova, Italy*€52,000 – €71,500*The stated salary comprises annual base pay and target variable compensation. The starting salary is determined using objective, gender neutral criteria, including relevant experience, qualifications, and role scope; prior compensation is not requested or considered. Employees also benefit from a comprehensive total rewards package, which may include further compensation and benefit elements depending on local regulations and company policies.#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.Are you in?We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.Learn more about our various contact channels (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/about-infineon/company/contacts/)  and about Diversity & Inclusion (https://www.infineon.com/cms/en/careers/diversity-and-inclusion/)  at Infineon.HRC1792713

title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive.
