description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: Marketing &amp; Commercial Manager (100%) Anglais – çais---Marketing \& Commercial Manager (100%) Anglais – çais========================================================Fondée le 14 avril 1900 à , l’Union Cycliste Internationale (UCI) est l’instance faîtière du cyclisme dans le monde. Sa mission consiste à développer et superviser le cyclisme sous toutes ses formes et pour tout le monde, en tant que sport de compétition, activité de loisir saine, et moyen de transport et de s’amuser. L’UCI assure par ailleurs la promotion de ses propres événements, notamment des Championnats du Monde Route UCI, manifestation annuelle emblématique, et d’un grand nombre d’autres Championnats du Monde et Coupes du Monde dans les différentes disciplines. Son siège se trouve à Aigle, en Suisse, au Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI. L’UCI est à la recherche d’un(e) : Marketing \& Commercial Manager (100%) Anglais – çais======================================================== **Mission:**Sous la supervision du Directeur Communication, Marketing, Médias et RSE, le/la Marketing \& Commercial Manager dirige la division Marketing and Commercial, qui réunit les partenariats, le servicing partenaires et le développement commercial de l’UCI. Il/elle est responsable de la conception, du suivi de la commercialisation et du pilotage des agences commerciales, de la livraison des packages marketing et sponsoring, , ainsi que de la stratégie merchandising et licensing de l’organisation.Il/elle joue un rôle clé dans la livraison des Championnats du Monde UCI et garantit la livraison optimale des engagements partenaires sur l’ensemble de nos Championnats du Monde. Il/elle développe et contribue à l’innovation digitale et au fan engagement, et entretient une relation de confiance avec les partenaires tout au long de l’année.  **Principales responsabilités**:* Manager la division Marketing and Commercial et encadrer son équipe (coordinateurs partenariats marketing et assistant commercial) : priorités, plan de charge et suivi des objectifs.  * Piloter les agences commerciales mandatées par l’UCI : objectifs, suivi des prospects, des négociations et du reporting.  * Superviser l’activité commerciale de l’UCI et du Centre Mondial du Cyclisme UCI.  * Concevoir, mettre à jour et commercialiser les packages marketing et sponsoring (droits marketing, hospitalités, activations, digital).  * Mener les négociations de nouveaux contrats et les renégociations des contrats existants.  * Identifier des opportunités innovantes de revenus et proposer de nouveaux concepts marketing.  * Être l’interlocuteur(trice) principal(e) des partenaires : coordination, réunions, communication et événements corporate.  * Superviser la livraison de toutes les contreparties marketing et activations sur les événements, en lien avec l’équipe Digital pour les activations digitales.  * Développer des initiatives dépassant le cadre contractuel pour renforcer la valeur partenariale et fidéliser les partenaires.  * Définir et valider la répartition des droits marketing pour chaque événement, assurer le suivi des contrats LOC, valider les partenaires locaux et organiser des visites de sites avec sponsors et LOC.  * Déployer et superviser la stratégie merchandising et licensing de la marque UCI « Rainbow » : gammes de produits, partenaires de production et de distribution, conformité de l’utilisation de la marque.  * Préparer, analyser et suivre le budget de la division ainsi que les revenus marketing et commerciaux.  * Toute autre mission liée au service marketing et commercial, selon les besoins du service.    **Profil:*** Formation supérieure en marketing, commerce, management du sport ou commerce international, idéalement avec une spécialisation en marketing sportif ou sponsoring, ou expérience équivalente.  * 7 à 10 ans d’expérience en marketing, partenariats, sponsoring ou vente de droits, de préférence dans le sport international ou l’événementiel.  * Expérience confirmée de la vente et de la négociation de partenariats, avec des résultats commerciaux démontrables.  * Expérience du pilotage d’agences commerciales ou de prestataires externes.  * Expérience confirmée en management d’équipe et en coordination de projets internationaux.  * Expérience de la livraison de contreparties partenaires et d’activations sur des événements sportifs majeurs.  * Connaissance du merchandising et du licensing.  * Capacité à développer et entretenir des relations solides avec les partenaires et les comités d’organisation locaux.  * Esprit créatif pour proposer des concepts marketing innovants et des activations digitales.  * Rigueur, sens de l’organisation et capacité à gérer les pics d’activité liés aux événements.  * Parfaite maîtrise du français et de l’anglais, écrit et oral.  * Intérêt pour le sport, idéalement le cyclisme.  * Disponible pour voyager et travailler ponctuellement les week\-ends.    **Entrée en fonction:** de suite ou à convenir Nous rejoindre, c’est avoir l’opportunité d’exploiter title: Development Specialist - Sorbent Structures (80-100%)
description: Get to know ClimeworksClimeworks is a leading high-quality carbon removal provider, combining decades of expertise in Direct Air Capture (DAC) technology with a holistic approach to carbon removal solutions.Climeworks advises companies on their carbon removal strategies and provides tailored portfolios of nature-based and engineered approaches, offering end-to-end services to help achieve net-zero goals. The company runs the world's first two DAC plants in Iceland, demonstrating its core commitment to high-quality carbon removal that is backed by over 15 years of pioneering research, development, and deployment.By advancing the most reliable solutions in the market, Climeworks accelerates the global transition to net zero, unlocking economic value for businesses, governments, and society.We foster a dynamic environment and are building a global purpose driven team. We are looking for disruptive thinkers, passionate achievers and inspiring leaders that are ready to take on the world’s greatest challenge.Will you join us?Your missionJob descriptionDevelopment Project OwnershipProject leadership: You define, lead, and interpret test campaigns and modelling activities to advance sorbent structure development and optimisation.Technical ownership: You act as the technical owner for selected development projects, translating strategic goals into structured plans and work packages.External partnerships: You collaborate with technology partners, research institutions, and suppliers to accelerate innovation and development.Cross-functional collaboration: You work closely with sorbent, manufacturing, characterisation, and industrialisation teams to support technology maturation and informed decision-making.Method development: You develop and apply analytical methods, characterisation techniques, and modelling tools to enhance development efficiency and performance. Operational and Laboratory ResponsibilitiesSorbent structures: You prepare, fabricate, and characterise new and existing sorbent structures to support development and testing campaigns from laboratory to pilot scale.Technical insights: You execute experimental work, analyse data, and communicate findings through clear documentation, technical reports, and presentations.Traceability: You maintain organised and reliable records of sorbent structure samples, test articles, and associated datasets to ensure full traceability.Scientific rigour: You reproduce, document, and validate experimental results in accordance with scientific best practices and established quality standards.Lab operations: You contribute to laboratory management through equipment maintenance, operational support, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement activities.Testing support: You actively support testing campaigns and characterisation activities to ensure timely delivery of project objectives.Safety: You follow and actively promote safe laboratory and workshop practices, fostering a strong culture of safety and compliance.Your storyRequirementsAcademic background: You hold an advanced degree in materials science, engineering, or a related field.R&D experience: You bring 2–5 years of experience in research and development.Technical expertise: You are skilled in immobilizing sorbents or catalysts in 3D structures and understand how their properties influence system performance.Stakeholder management: You demonstrate excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.Hands-on mentality: You take initiative, are results-driven, and work hands-on from laboratory activities to high-level evaluations.Language skills: You are fluent in English. Nice to have:Industry experience: You bring experience from the catalysis, air filtration, or functional textiles industries.Process expertise: You have experience with gas separation processes.Characterization skills: You are experienced in material and structural characterization techniques.Our promise: At Climeworks, you are accepted for who you are, and we are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued. We encourage all qualified applicants to apply – regardless of background, identity, or experience. Studies show that women and individuals from minority backgrounds often only apply for jobs when they meet 100% of the listed criteria. If this sounds like you, don’t hold back. If you think you’d make a great fit for this role, we’d love to hear from you, even if you don’t check every single box. Let’s tackle one of humankind’s greatest challenges together.What we offer:Time Off: Enjoy 25 paid vacation days every year, plus public holidays.Flexibility: Work how it suits you best. We offer a hybrid work setup and up to 4 weeks of remote work annually within any EU country.Ownership: Fair base pay paired with an equity package – because your contributions matter.Family Support: Inclusive parental leave.Continuous Learning: Dedicated budget to invest in your professional growth.Referral Rewards: Help us grow our team and earn bonuses for your successful referrals.Salary: At Climeworks, salary ranges are assigned to a job based on the level of seniority and the location specific market median of similar jobs according to external benchmark surveys. Individual compensation depends on your skills, experience, and the value you bring to the team.Formalities: This position is based in Opfikon, Zurich, and we ask that you work onsite at least three days per week.The percentage in the job title means flexibility – choose full-time or part-time based on what works for you.We do not accept candidate profiles through recruitment agencies.

title: AI Architect 100%
description: # AI Architect**Location** · Zurich, Switzerland## About the RoleWe’re looking for an AI Architect to lead the technical strategy for AI across our products and internal systems. You’ll turn business priorities into architecture decisions and guide AI initiatives from use case definition through to production. Your focus will be on building secure, scalable, and cost-effective cloud solutions that teams can operate and maintain.You’ll work closely with data scientists, ML engineers, software architects, product leaders, and executives to set technical direction, explain trade-offs, and guide delivery.## Key Responsibilities### Architecture and strategy- Design end-to-end AI and ML architectures covering data ingestion, model training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.- Define the enterprise AI roadmap, reference architectures, and technology standards.- Lead build-versus-buy assessments for foundation models, open-source models, and vendor platforms.### Cloud architecture- Design and lead the delivery of cloud-native AI solutions on AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud using managed AI services and scalable infrastructure.- Define cloud landing zones, networking, identity and access management, and security patterns for AI workloads.- Develop hybrid or multi-cloud strategies where appropriate, taking data residency into account.- Optimize cloud cost and performance through FinOps practices, including GPU capacity planning and autoscaling.### Generative AI and large language models- Design applications that use large language models (LLMs), including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), agentic workflows, tool integration, and fine-tuning.- Define evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and monitoring for model quality, safety, latency, and cost.- Evaluate model and retrieval performance against business use cases and establish standards for managing prompts, context, and models.### ML platforms and MLOps- Lead the design of scalable ML platforms, including feature stores, vector databases, model registries, CI/CD pipelines, and inference infrastructure.- Design production AI systems for reliability, scalability, and disaster recovery.### Governance, security, and responsible AI- Embed security, privacy, and responsible AI principles into solution design. Work with legal and compliance teams to address applicable requirements and assurance standards.- Define standards for bias testing, explainability, auditability, and data governance.- Partner with legal, security, and risk teams to develop and implement AI policies.### Technical leadership and collaboration- Align business stakeholders, engineering teams, vendors, and cloud providers on architecture decisions and delivery priorities.- Mentor ML engineers, data scientists, and software teams.- Explain AI capabilities, risks, and trade-offs to executives and non-technical stakeholders.- Produce and review technical documentation, architecture decision records, and presentations.- Lead architecture reviews, proofs of concept, and vendor evaluations.- Follow developments in AI research, tools, and industry practices to inform technology decisions.## Required Experience and Technical Skills- **8+ years in software or data engineering**, including **4+ years designing and delivering production AI or ML solutions**.- **5+ years of hands-on cloud experience**, with deep expertise in at least one major platform and its AI services, such as AWS SageMaker and Bedrock, Azure AI and Azure OpenAI Service, or Google Cloud Vertex AI.- Proven experience designing cloud-native systems using serverless services, containers, Docker, Kubernetes, networking, identity and access management, and security best practices.- Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Bicep, and with managing cloud costs.- Deep understanding of machine learning, deep learning, large language models, and generative AI techniques.- Hands-on Python experience with tools such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face libraries, and experience with LangChain or LlamaIndex.- Proven MLOps experience, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and workflow orchestration.- Strong knowledge of data architecture, including data lakes and warehouses, streaming, vector databases, and ETL/ELT pipelines.- Experience designing secure, scalable distributed systems and APIs.- Strong communication, stakeholder management, and technical documentation skills.## Preferred Qualifications- Professional cloud certifications in architecture, AI, or machine learning from AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.- Experience designing hybrid or multi-cloud architectures and leading cloud migrations.- Experience building multi-agent systems and agentic AI architectures.- Familiarity with model adaptation and optimization techniques such as LoRA, RLHF, distillation, and quantization, and with inference tools such as vLLM or TensorRT.- Experience in regulated environments such as financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, or government.- Published research, patents, or open-source contributions.## Key Competencies- Systems thinking and sound architectural judgment.- Ability to work effectively across functions and cultures.- Practical judgment when balancing innovation, delivery, cost, and risk.- Ownership and sound decision-making when requirements are still evolving.- Ability to influence decisions without direct authority.- Commitment to ethical and responsible AI.

HR Business Partner
===================

**The company**

The Swatch Group Services Ltd. is a dynamic company of the Swatch Group providing high quality services to the Group organizations worldwide in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management Real Estate \& Gems. The company belongs to the Swatch Group, the world's largest watch maker with a portfolio of 16 brands of which Breguet, Harry Winston, Blancpain, Glashütte Original, Jaquet Droz, Omega, Longines, Rado, Union Glashütte, Tissot, Balmain, Certina, Mido, Hamilton, Swatch and Flik Flak.

Swatch Group Services offers a unique ecosystem where people can accomplish their goals and achieve their aspirations. To strengthen our HR team, we are offering an exciting opportunity based between Biel (60%) and Neuchâtel (40%), with flexibility to discuss the allocation. We are currently looking for an:

**HR Business Partner (100%)**

**Job description**

In this role, you will manage the complete employee life cycle and support our managers as a coach and consultant, helping them guide their teams toward success. Your mission? Build a great work environment, solve challenges with style, and contribute to the vibrant culture of our company.

**Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Act as the main point of contact for employees and managers (\>150 employees)
* Lead end\-to\-end recruitment and staffing for The Swatch Group Services in the fields of Logistics, Customer Services, Quality Management, Real Estate as well as for the Group's companies based in Neuchâtel.
* Be a partner with managers to analyse needs and select top talent.
* Negotiate offers, prepare contracts, and ensure smooth onboarding \& offboarding.
* Provide guidance on employee relations, performance topics, and change initiatives.
* Support managers in handling discussions, resolving issues, and navigating team conflicts.
* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.
* Follow up on development needs and action plans.
* Handle warnings and contract terminations.


At Swatch Group Services, we value fresh ideas, especially in areas like employer branding, employee retention \& HR process optimization, to keep improving our quality standards and elevating the employee experience.

**Professional requirements**

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.
* You are a natural networker, collaborate efficiently with everybody and you build a trustful relationship at all levels and be regarded as a trusted partner.
* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.
* You have an excellent consultative and client service skill with the ability to effectively influence and manage key relationships with a strong knowledge of Swiss law.
* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.
* Any other languages are welcome \- we have 29 so far in the company, if you wish to add the 30th, you pretty much know what to do

**Contact**

A dynamic and evolving work environment, complemented by attractive benefits:

* Continuous training to support your professional development
* Career growth opportunities through our internal mobility policy
* 5 to 6 weeks of vacation per year, depending on your age and/or position
* A 40\-hour work week, in line with the collective labor agreement (CCT)
* Competitive salary and excellent social benefits
* Parental leave: up to 3 weeks for the other parent and 19 weeks for mothers
* On\-site company restaurant with employer financial contribution
* Exclusive discounts on Swatch Group products and with our partners
* Sports activities and internal events to foster team spirit
* Contribution to health insurance costs

title: CEO
description: ---base:meta-keywords:meta-viewport: width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0title: CEO (all genders)--- CEO (all genders)=================CEO (all genders)-----------------Execution, growth and the path to profitabilityYou take over overall responsibility for day\-to\-day business from the founder and drive the execution of our strategy, market launches and expansion. You own the P\&L and lead Tortuga Sense from market entry to a scaling, profitable company, reaching break\-even according to plan and preparing the next financing round on solid numbers. **Workload:** 100%**Location:** Zug, Switzerland**Start date:** Q1 2027**Reports to:** Board of Directors Tortuga Sense is a Swiss preventive health company: science\-based supplements, diagnostics and , our AI\-powered health companion, complemented by an academy and a community under the claim “From Cell to Consciousness”. The portfolio is in market and expansion beyond Switzerland is under way.Today, the Chairman of the Board, one of the founders, fills the CEO role ad interim. You lead a growing team, including a Head of Marketing joining in Q1 2027\. The Board owns the strategy. You are involved from day one and take the lead in developing it over the medium term. We deliberately stay lean and use current AI tools and automation wherever they make us faster and keep costs under control. ### **About Tortuga Sense*** **Markets:** Switzerland since spring 2026, Germany and Austria since November 2026 through an EU fulfilment partner, APAC planned for Q2 2027 through a joint venture.* **Range:** Eleven products in four lines (ELEMENT, CORE, COGNITION, REGENERATION), growing to 15 to 20 by the end of 2027\. Proprietary formulations built on clinically studied branded ingredients, made with our pharma\-grade Swiss partner (cGMP, ISO 9001, FSSC 22000, HACCP).* **Channels:** Our own D2C webshop plus B2B through physicians, therapists, pharmacies and studios, trained through our Deep Sense programme. Five practitioner partners are on board, more are in negotiation.*  **:** Turns blood values, personal goals and lifestyle information into personalised supplement recommendations. Developed by our parent company, version 1 planned for 2027; Tortuga Sense is its licensee and first user.### **Your responsibilities*** Translate the strategy into an annual plan, budget and quarterly targets, and deliver on them. Lead the management team and develop the strategy further with the Board.* Own the P\&L. Finance leadership currently sits with the Chairman, supported by finance administration. You work closely within it and build budget control, KPIs and reporting.* Own revenue and unit economics across D2C and the practitioner channel, together with the Head of Marketing.* Expand the practitioner channel: a closed area with in\-depth information for professional customers (two areas), and scalable onboarding and acquisition supported by automation, together with the Deep Sense Academy.* Run operations: the flow of goods from manufacturer via fulfilment partner to customer, inventory and liquidity, customer service and the set\-up of the EU entity.* Generate ideas for new products together with the Chairman, the board member responsible for medical and the Head of Marketing, and contribute to the profitability of the portfolio.* Own market launches and expansion: lead country set\-up and market access through the regulatory staff function, which reports to you with direct escalation to the Board, and represent Tortuga Sense in the APAC joint venture.* Anchor in sales and customer care, and define its requirements from our perspective as its first customer.* Lead and develop the team, including a Head of Marketing joining in Q1 2027 and a growing number of employees, and protect the company’s mindset as it grows.* Support the next financing round, led by the Chairman: deliver figures, KPIs and planning, and answer investors’ questions.* **Division of roles:** Product development, formulations, claims and medical sit with board members in active roles and our manufacturing partner; development, IP and data sit with our parent company. The Board retains overall direction and strategy, finance leadership, group structure, capital rounds, budget approval and appointments to the management team.### **What you bring*** You have played a key role in building a digital brand or start\-up from an early stage, as founder, managing director, COO, CMO or first executive, and now want overall responsibility. What you have built counts for more than years of service.* Shaped by start\-ups, D2C or digital consumer brands, ideally in health, supplements or wellbeing. Not a corporate or pharma profile.* Deep expertise in at least one core area of a consumer brand, whether operations, finance, growth or marketing, and the breadth to lead and challenge the others without doing those jobs yourself.* Strong with numbers: you think unit economics, inventory and liquidity together.* You work with current AI tools as a matter of course and can show where automation made processes faster or leaner.* regulatory understanding of dietary supplements.* Business\-fluent and English.* You share our purpose: “We don’t sell pills. We build rituals.” Prevention and awareness are a personal concern, not just a market segment.* Entrepreneurial, clear and calm. You say what is, don’t overpromise, and deliver. You lead without ego and work closely with founders who sit on the Board and hold active roles: you draw on their knowledge and still set boundaries.### **This is a plus*** Experience with contract manufacturers and fulfilment partners.* Practitioner or partner sales in a health setting.* Experience with digital health products.* Experience building international markets.* Fundraising experience is not a requirement.### **What awaits you*** Overall responsibility for day\-to\-day business, alongside an active Chairman with thirty years of entrepreneurial experience who hands over step by step.* The chance to build the leadership team around your strengths and help choose the next key hires.* An independent brand with a medical foundation, exclusive formulations and an ecosystem of product, health intelligence and community.* A fixed salary at start\-up level and a substantial, performance\-based equity participation in Tortuga Sense AG.In your first 60 days, you have taken over the 2027 budget and the organisation, and the delegation of authority is lived in practice. A KPI cockpit covering cohorts, CAC, repeat purchase and contribution margin is in place, clear priorities are agreed with the Head of Marketing, and the next key hires are defined.By mid\-2027, Germany and Austria are on track against their targets and APAC has launched. v1 is part of the sales process, the professional area is live with scalable practitioner onboarding, and supply runs without bottlenecks.By the end of 2027, the data room and figures for the next financing round are ready, the range comprises 15 to 20 products, the practitioner channel is significantly expanded, and there is a proven path to break\-even.**Sound like you?**Then we would like to talk. Send us a few lines about yourself, two or three things you have built with the numbers behind them, and one example of how you used AI or automation to change the way a business works. No formal cover letter required. Feel free to apply in either English or . Please also mention your notice period and possible starting date.For further questions, feel free to reach out to us directly.![Purpur Ventures AG]()* Purpur Ventures AG  Grienbachstrasse 17  6300 Zug*jid4e2e308jm jit1148jm jiy26jm

Le processus comprend deux tests : un test de personnalité et un test cognitif. description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable Conformité (100%) --- Responsable Conformité (100%) ============================== L'Office cantonal des assurances sociales est une institution autonome de droit public et constitue un pôle de compétences dans les assurances sociales du 1er pilier. Il gère et coordonne quatre régimes d'assurance : assurance\\-vieillesse et survivants, assurance\\-invalidité, allocations familiales et allocations pour perte de gain. Pour relever les défis actuels, l'OCAS est à la recherche d'un\\-e \*\*Responsable conformité\*\* (100 %) Classe de fonction 23 Au sein du domaine des services partagés et rattaché\\-e au responsable adjoint du domaine, vous avez pour mission de construire et piloter le nouveau secteur conformité de l'OCAS. Vous donnez à l'institution une vue unique de sa maîtrise en matière de gestion des risques, de contrôle interne, de qualité, de sécurité de l'information et de protection des données. Pour ce faire, vous réunissez et développez les dispositifs existants que la loi impose aux organes d'exécution du 1er pilier. Dans un contexte réglementaire exigeant et en évolution, vous priorisez selon les risques que l'institution doit maîtriser. Dans une logique de deuxième ligne de maîtrise, vous élaborez et déployez progressivement le cadre méthodologique, accompagnez la mise en œuvre par les secteurs et les domaines, qui restent responsables de leurs risques, et contrôlez l'efficacité du dispositif. Vous rendez compte de l'état de maîtrise à la direction générale et à la commission risques du conseil d'administration. Vous conduisez une équipe de deux spécialistes en sécurité de l'information et en protection des données. Ce poste s'adresse à une personnalité fédératrice et résolue, dotée d'un bon esprit de synthèse, capable de faire appliquer des exigences de maîtrise sans se substituer aux métiers. \*\*Vos title: Responsable de production senior à 100%
description: --- base: meta-keywords: meta-viewport: width=device-width, title: Responsable de production senior à 100% (H/F) --- Responsable de production senior à 100% (H/F) ============================================== ### Introduction TRIDEL SA est une société anonyme reconnue d'utilité publique, dont le siège est à Lausanne. Nous valorisons thermiquement les déchets triés par les communes de nos périmètres actionnaires ainsi que par nos clients privés, principalement dans le canton de Vaud. Une partie des déchets arrive à l'usine par train. Pour renforcer notre organisation, nous recherchons un \*\*Responsable de production senior à 100% (H/F)\*\*, à un niveau de fonction comportant des responsabilités. ### Votre mission Intégré au sein de l'équipe d'exploitation et directement rattaché au responsable de département, vous jouez un rôle clé dans la définition et la mise en œuvre de la stratégie d'exploitation de l'usine. Vous assurez une exploitation efficace des installations de l'usine et du circuit thermique et participez aux travaux de révision et à des projets d'amélioration des installations. En collaboration avec l'ingénieur d'exploitation, vous participez aux contrôles ASIT (Association Suisse d'Inspection Technique). Vous pilotez la production hebdomadaire d'énergie en fonction des apports, veillez à la bonne application des processus et assurez le contrôle de la conformité des déchets, notamment en matière d'apports non conformes et de radioprotection. De par votre rôle de manager, vous accompagnez 5 équipes, soit 15 collaborateurs, en favorisant leur développement et la cohésion des équipes. Vous assurez également la planification du personnel, notamment la gestion des absences et des vacances. ### Votre profil Titulaire du Brevet fédéral de thermiste, d'un CFC dans un métier technique ou ingénieur HES (ou formation jugée équivalente), vous avez quelques années d'expérience confirmée dans une usine de valorisation thermique de déchets ou en milieu industriel. Vous êtes un manager expérimenté, fort de 10 ans d'expérience dans la conduite et le management d'équipes, prêt à assumer des responsabilités et à jouer un rôle clé dans l'accompagnement et le développement de vos collaborateurs. Grâce à votre leadership naturel, votre sens de l'écoute et vos qualités de communication, vous savez fédérer vos collaborateurs et instaurer une dynamique de travail positive. Organisé et autonome, vous faites preuve d'initiative, prenez des décisions avec discernement et vous appuyez sur vos capacités d'analyse et de synthèse pour relever les défis du quotidien. Sensible aux enjeux environnementaux, vous souhaitez mettre votre expérience et vos compétences au service d'une mission concrète et porteuse de sens. De bonnes connaissances orales de l'allemand constituent un atout supplémentaire. \*\*Conditions spéciales :\*\* \* Service de piquet \* Casier judiciaire vierge \*\*Nous vous offrons :\*\* \* Des prestations sociales attractives et des possibilités de flexibiliser son temps de travail \* Le développement de vos compétences professionnelles au sein d'une entreprise qui fait de la formation continue un élément clé de sa stratégie RH \* Un cadre de travail moderne, avec des technologies très évoluées \*\*Entrée en fonction :\*\* ou à convenir \*\*Postulation :\*\* Si vous êtes motivé à relever ce défi et à contribuer à la mission de TRIDEL SA, nous vous invitons à soumettre votre candidature dès à présent, en ligne, jusqu'au \*\*15 décembre 2026\*\*. Nous nous réjouissons de découvrir votre profil et d'échanger avec vous. Des renseignements complémentaires peuvent être obtenus auprès de Monsieur Grégory Vaucher, Responsable exploitation \\\& délégué à la sécurité au tél. : 021 331 14 03\\. !\[TRIDEL SA\]( ) \* TRIDEL SA Rue Sera\\-Biasini 35 1005 Lausanne \* \[ \](\< \>) jpid3ac10edjm jpit1148jm jpiy26jm

including offerings, methodologies, alliances, and thought leadership.* Maintain a high degree of client satisfaction, proactively manage delivery and commercial risks, and resolve complex client challenges.* Contribute to the growth of the practice through recruiting, mentoring, coaching, talent development, and knowledge sharing. **What we look for*** Extensive experience, typically 8\-10 planning, S\&OP / IBP, inventory optimization, and production planning.* Proven track record of independently originating and driving multimillion\-value consulting sales, from opportunity management, and Agile delivery are advantageous; knowledge of AI, machine learning, process automation, digital twins, or other emerging planning technologies is a plus. **What's in it for you**Here **Introduction de la société**

**Swatch Group est un groupe international, dont l'activité porte sur la production et la vente de montres terminées, de bijoux et de composants et mouvements horlogers. Swatch Group fournit la quasi\-totalité des composants nécessaires à la fabrication des montres vendues par ses 17 marques horlogères et de joaillerie, ainsi que par ses deux marques de distribution.**

**Description du poste**

Pour renforcer notre département juridique basé à Bienne, nous recherchons de suite ou à convenir, un/e

**Spécialiste en marques et modèles (h/f/d) 100%**

#### Tâches principales

Gestion des portefeuilles de marques et de modèles des sociétés du Swatch Group notamment :

 

* Conseils aux sociétés du Groupe sur la protection de leurs marques et modèles
* Dépôt, renouvellement et analyse des portefeuilles de marques et modèles
* Recherches de disponibilités de marques et surveillance de marques et modèles nouvellement déposés
* Traitement et gestion des preuves d'usage des marques
* Traitement des litiges, selon les cas en collaboration avec des avocats externes
* Suivi des différentes procédures et des délais
* Instruction aux avocats externes et gestion de ceux \- ci.
* Reporting au management
* Diverses tâches administratives liées à la gestion des portefeuilles


 

**Profil**

#### **Profil requis**

 

* Spécialiste en droit des marques et modèles avec formation juridique ou dans une HEG
* Plusieurs années d'expérience dans le domaine de la protection des marques et modèles, de préférence dans un environnement international.
* Langue maternelle française ou allemande avec d'excellentes connaissances de l'autre langue, très bon niveau d'anglais (écrit et oral)
* Esprit d'équipe, loyauté, disponibilité, flexibilité et sens des responsabilités
* Précision, autonomie, réactivité et esprit d'analyse


**Compétences requises**

Nous vous offrons un travail varié et passionnant dans un environnement international. Nous apprécions les relations interpersonnelles et la communication physique et directe avec nos collaborateurs, c'est pourquoi nous ne pratiquons pas de télétravail.

description: Ref 2575930 \| Date: 19 Nov 2026![Swiss Medical Network]( )Montchoisi\-MotionLabDescription de l'entreprise---------------------------**Physiothérapeute Junior ou Senior \- Orthopédie \& Sport (H/F)****MotionLab \- Site de Montchoisi****MotionLab : l'excellence en santé, rééducation et performance**Depuis 2019, MotionLab s'impose comme un centre de référence en Suisse dans les domaines de la santé, de la rééducation et de la performance sportive. Notre approche repose sur l'expertise clinique, l'innovation et la collaboration multidisciplinaire entre physiothérapeutes, médecins spécialistes, préparateurs physiques et autres professionnels de la santé.Intégré à Swiss Medical Network depuis 2024, MotionLab bénéficie d'un accès privilégié à l'un des plus importants réseaux de santé privés de Suisse. Dans le cadre du développement de ses activités sur l'Arc lémanique, MotionLab renforce aujourd'hui son équipe de physiothérapie sur son site de Montchoisi, en étroite collaboration avec les spécialistes de la Clinique de Montchoisi, établissement reconnu pour son expertise en orthopédie.Nous recherchons un(e) Physiothérapeute Senior ou junior souhaitant évoluer dans un environnement dynamique, innovant et orienté vers l'excellence clinique, tout en participant activement au développement des prestations et des projets de MotionLab.Description du poste--------------------**Votre rôle**En tant que Physiothérapeute, vous serez amené(e) à :**Activités cliniques*** Prendre en charge des patients hospitalisés en orthopédie.* Assurer le traitement de patients ambulatoires en orthopédie, chirurgie du rachis, traumatologie, rhumatologie et médecine du sport.* Participer au développement de l'activité ambulatoire et des prestations spécialisées.* Gérer des situations cliniques complexes, chroniques ou présentant des échecs thérapeutiques.* Assurer la coordination avec les médecins prescripteurs et les différents intervenants du parcours de soins.* Développer une expertise spécifique dans certains domaines (retour au sport, genou/LCA, épaule, rachis, pelvi\-périnéologie, etc.).**Leadership et développement*** Définir et faire évoluer les standards de prise en charge, protocoles et recommandations internes.* Garantir la qualité et la cohérence des traitements au sein de l'équipe.* Assurer un rôle de référent clinique dans votre domaine d'expertise.* Participer activement au mentorat et à l'accompagnement des physiothérapeutes juniors.* Contribuer à la création et au développement du réseau professionnel de MotionLab.* Participer à la gestion de projets liés aux prestations du centre.* Contribuer au développement de nouvelles offres et à la croissance de l'activité.* Être impliqué(e) dans la dynamique et le management de l'équipe.Qualifications--------------**Votre profil*** Diplôme de physiothérapeute suisse ou titre équivalent reconnu par la Croix\-Rouge suisse.* Expérience confirmée dans le domaine ambulatoire musculo\-squelettique et orthopédique.* Formation complémentaire en physiothérapie du sport ou spécialisation* Expérience en rééducation sportive et intérêt pour les évaluations de performance.* Leadership naturel et goût pour la transmission des connaissances.* Dynamisme, esprit d'initiative et sens des responsabilités.* Autonomie, flexibilité, polyvalence et engagement.* Sens de l'organisation et aptitude au travail en équipe.* Grande capacité d'adaptation.* Intérêt marqué pour l'innovation, les nouvelles technologies et l'approche multidisciplinaire.* Désir de s'engager dans **Profile**

**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Organise and control of the yearly evaluation and talent management process, and follow\-up with measures if needed.

* University degree in HR or equivalent (Brevet fédéral) with over 5 years of experience in a similar role.

* You get a strong experience in Recruitment ideally in the Supply Chain field. Hands on in sourcing.

* Autonomous and self\-motivated, with initiative and an ability to manage multiple priorities with a sense of urgency.
* You are data driven as well as highly organized: You have a very structured way of working, being able to prioritize a variety of complex tasks and to complete them diligently


**You're missing one or two skills in the list, yet you're eager to learn?  
It's perfectly OK. We like to share.**

**Languages**

Now, in order to blend in, socially and professionally, we certainly recommend the following languages:

* Fluent in French and in English, combined with good knowledge of German considered an asset.

title: Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling
description: Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling Postdoc in Computational Systems Biology and Metabolic Modeling===============================================================Dysregulation of lipid metabolism plays a key role in the development and progression of metabolic disorders, including obesity, type 2 diabetes, and metabolic dysfunction\-associated steatotic liver disease (MASLD). We are seeking a highly motivated Scientist in Computational and Systems Biology to work on a project funded by the Swiss National Science Foundation (SNSF) aimed at advancing our understanding of human lipid metabolism in MASLD. The project focuses on modelling human metabolism by integrating clinical data with experimental models. It involves biochemical and molecular data from multiple tissues and biofluids to investigate tissue\-specific metabolism, metabolic interactions across organs, and nutrient uptake, transformation, and release. The project combines statistical modelling, systems biology, and in silico metabolic modelling with clinical, transcriptomic, proteomic, metabolomic/lipidomic, spatial molecular imaging, and experimental metabolic flux data to provide new insights into the complex metabolic alterations underlying MASLD.**What you can expect*** Develop and apply mathematical, statistical, and machine\-learning models to complex, high\-dimensional, and multimodal biological and clinical datasets, including spatial and imaging data* Model lipid and nutrient metabolism using compartmental, kinetic, mechanistic, metabolic network, or physiologically based approaches* Reconstruct and model tissue\-specific metabolic networks and validate model predictions using experimental data* Participate in and contribute to multidisciplinary and collaborative research projects.* Prepare, present, and communicate scientific findings at internal meetings, international conferences, and through peer\-reviewed publications**Your Profile*** PhD or equivalent in computational biology, systems biology, applied mathematics, biochemical engineering, or a related field* Strong expertise in mathematical and statistical modelling, machine learning, and systems biology, with experience analysing high\-dimensional, multimodal, or multi\-omics biological or clinical data* Demonstrated experience in in silico metabolic modelling, e.g. constraint\-based or genome\-scale metabolic modelling, metabolic network reconstruction, kinetic or metabolic flux modelling, or data\-driven simulation* Proficiency in R, , or MATLAB and experience integrating experimental data with computational models;* Experience in mass spectrometry, spatial omics, molecular imaging, or tissue imaging is a strong asset* Enthusiastic and collaborative scientist with strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, the ability to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams, and excellent written and spoken English**What we offer*** A supportive, collaborative, and state\-of\-the\-art research environment with opportunities for scientific and professional development* Participation in multidisciplinary research projects at the interface of computational biology, systems biology, metabolism, multi\-omics, molecular imaging, and clinical research* The opportunity to work with large datasets from pre\-clinical and clinical studies* Close collaboration with experts from different scientific and clinical disciplines**Questions about the job?**For further information, please contact **Prof. Mojgan Masoodi** Head of ResearchINSELSPITAL  3010 Berne![INSELSPITAL]()jid409e4f3jm jit1148jm jiy26jm
